verses.genesis 1:1: Genesis 1:1 In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:2: Genesis 1:2 The earth was without form, and void; and darkness was on the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the face of the waters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:3: Genesis 1:3 Then God said, "Let there be light"; and there was light.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:4: Genesis 1:4 And God saw the light, that it was good; and God divided the light from the darkness.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:5: Genesis 1:5 God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. So the evening and the morning were the first day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:6: Genesis 1:6 Then God said, "Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:7: Genesis 1:7 Thus God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament; and it was so.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:8: Genesis 1:8 And God called the firmament Heaven. So the evening and the morning were the second day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:9: Genesis 1:9 Then God said, "Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together into one place, and let the dry land appear"; and it was so.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:10: Genesis 1:10 And God called the dry land Earth, and the gathering together of the waters He called Seas. And God saw that it was good.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:11: Genesis 1:11 Then God said, "Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb that yields seed, and the fruit tree that yields fruit according to its kind, whose seed is in itself, on the earth"; and it was so.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:12: Genesis 1:12 And the earth brought forth grass, the herb that yields seed according to its kind, and the tree that yields fruit, whose seed is in itself according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:13: Genesis 1:13 So the evening and the morning were the third day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:14: Genesis 1:14 Then God said, "Let there be lights in the firmament of the heavens to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs and seasons, and for days and years;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:15: Genesis 1:15 and let them be for lights in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth"; and it was so.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:16: Genesis 1:16 Then God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He made the stars also.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:17: Genesis 1:17 God set them in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:18: Genesis 1:18 and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:19: Genesis 1:19 So the evening and the morning were the fourth day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:20: Genesis 1:20 Then God said, "Let the waters abound with an abundance of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the face of the firmament of the heavens."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:21: Genesis 1:21 So God created great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters abounded, according to their kind, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:22: Genesis 1:22 And God blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:23: Genesis 1:23 So the evening and the morning were the fifth day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:24: Genesis 1:24 Then God said, "Let the earth bring forth the living creature according to its kind: cattle and creeping thing and beast of the earth, each according to its kind"; and it was so.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:25: Genesis 1:25 And God made the beast of the earth according to its kind, cattle according to its kind, and everything that creeps on the earth according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:26: Genesis 1:26 Then God said, "Let Us make man in Our image, according to Our likeness; let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, and over the cattle, over all the earth and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:27: Genesis 1:27 So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:28: Genesis 1:28 Then God blessed them, and God said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply; fill the earth and subdue it; have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, and over every living thing that moves on the earth."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:29: Genesis 1:29 And God said, "See, I have given you every herb that yields seed which is on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit yields seed; to you it shall be for food.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:30: Genesis 1:30 Also, to every beast of the earth, to every bird of the air, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food"; and it was so.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 1:31: Genesis 1:31 Then God saw everything that He had made, and indeed it was very good. So the evening and the morning were the sixth day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:1: Genesis 2:1 Thus the heavens and the earth, and all the host of them, were finished.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:2: Genesis 2:2 And on the seventh day God ended His work which He had done, and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:3: Genesis 2:3 Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because in it He rested from all His work which God had created and made.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:4: Genesis 2:4 This is the history of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:5: Genesis 2:5 before any plant of the field was in the earth and before any herb of the field had grown. For the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth, and there was no man to till the ground;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:6: Genesis 2:6 but a mist went up from the earth and watered the whole face of the ground.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:7: Genesis 2:7 And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living being.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:8: Genesis 2:8 The LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden, and there He put the man whom He had formed.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:9: Genesis 2:9 And out of the ground the LORD God made every tree grow that is pleasant to the sight and good for food. The tree of life was also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:10: Genesis 2:10 Now a river went out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it parted and became four riverheads.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:11: Genesis 2:11 The name of the first is Pishon; it is the one which skirts the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:12: Genesis 2:12 And the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and the onyx stone are there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:13: Genesis 2:13 The name of the second river is Gihon; it is the one which goes around the whole land of Cush.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:14: Genesis 2:14 The name of the third river is Hiddekel; it is the one which goes toward the east of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:15: Genesis 2:15 Then the LORD God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to tend and keep it.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:16: Genesis 2:16 And the LORD God commanded the man, saying, "Of every tree of the garden you may freely eat;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:17: Genesis 2:17 but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:18: Genesis 2:18 And the LORD God said, "It is not good that man should be alone; I will make him a helper comparable to him."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:19: Genesis 2:19 Out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and brought them to Adam to see what he would call them. And whatever Adam called each living creature, that was its name.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:20: Genesis 2:20 So Adam gave names to all cattle, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. But for Adam there was not found a helper comparable to him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:21: Genesis 2:21 And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall on Adam, and he slept; and He took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:22: Genesis 2:22 Then the rib which the LORD God had taken from man He made into a woman, and He brought her to the man.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:23: Genesis 2:23 And Adam said: "This is now bone of my bones And flesh of my flesh; She shall be called Woman, Because she was taken out of Man."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:24: Genesis 2:24 Therefore a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and they shall become one flesh.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 2:25: Genesis 2:25 And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:1: Genesis 3:1 Now the serpent was more cunning than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said to the woman, "Has God indeed said, "˜You shall not eat of every tree of the garden'?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:2: Genesis 3:2 And the woman said to the serpent, "We may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:3: Genesis 3:3 but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God has said, "˜You shall not eat it, nor shall you touch it, lest you die.' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:4: Genesis 3:4 Then the serpent said to the woman, "You will not surely die.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:5: Genesis 3:5 For God knows that in the day you eat of it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:6: Genesis 3:6 So when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree desirable to make one wise, she took of its fruit and ate. She also gave to her husband with her, and he ate.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:7: Genesis 3:7 Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together and made themselves coverings.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:8: Genesis 3:8 And they heard the sound of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:9: Genesis 3:9 Then the LORD God called to Adam and said to him, "Where are you?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:10: Genesis 3:10 So he said, "I heard Your voice in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; and I hid myself."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:11: Genesis 3:11 And He said, "Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you that you should not eat?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:12: Genesis 3:12 Then the man said, "The woman whom You gave to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I ate."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:13: Genesis 3:13 And the LORD God said to the woman, "What is this you have done?" The woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:14: Genesis 3:14 So the LORD God said to the serpent: "Because you have done this, You are cursed more than all cattle, And more than every beast of the field; On your belly you shall go, And you shall eat dust All the days of your life.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:15: Genesis 3:15 And I will put enmity Between you and the woman, And between your seed and her Seed;  He shall bruise your head, And you shall bruise His heel."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:16: Genesis 3:16 To the woman He said: "I will greatly multiply your sorrow and your conception;  In pain you shall bring forth children;  Your desire shall be for your husband, And he shall rule over you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:17: Genesis 3:17 Then to Adam He said, "Because you have heeded the voice of your wife, and have eaten from the tree of which I commanded you, saying, "˜You shall not eat of it':  "Cursed is the ground for your sake;  In toil you shall eat of it All the days of your life.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:18: Genesis 3:18 Both thorns and thistles it shall bring forth for you, And you shall eat the herb of the field.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:19: Genesis 3:19 In the sweat of your face you shall eat bread Till you return to the ground, For out of it you were taken;  For dust you are, And to dust you shall return."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:20: Genesis 3:20 And Adam called his wife's name Eve, because she was the mother of all living.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:21: Genesis 3:21 Also for Adam and his wife the LORD God made tunics of skin, and clothed them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:22: Genesis 3:22 Then the LORD God said, "Behold, the man has become like one of Us, to know good and evil. And now, lest he put out his hand and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever""”(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:23: Genesis 3:23 therefore the LORD God sent him out of the garden of Eden to till the ground from which he was taken.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 3:24: Genesis 3:24 So He drove out the man; and He placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:1: Genesis 4:1 Now Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain, and said, "I have acquired a man from the LORD."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:2: Genesis 4:2 Then she bore again, this time his brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:3: Genesis 4:3 And in the process of time it came to pass that Cain brought an offering of the fruit of the ground to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:4: Genesis 4:4 Abel also brought of the firstborn of his flock and of their fat. And the LORD respected Abel and his offering,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:5: Genesis 4:5 but He did not respect Cain and his offering. And Cain was very angry, and his countenance fell.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:6: Genesis 4:6 So the LORD said to Cain, "Why are you angry? And why has your countenance fallen?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:7: Genesis 4:7 If you do well, will you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin lies at the door. And its desire is for you, but you should rule over it."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:8: Genesis 4:8 Now Cain talked with Abel his brother; and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:9: Genesis 4:9 Then the LORD said to Cain, "Where is Abel your brother?" He said, "I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:10: Genesis 4:10 And He said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries out to Me from the ground.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:11: Genesis 4:11 So now you are cursed from the earth, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:12: Genesis 4:12 When you till the ground, it shall no longer yield its strength to you. A fugitive and a vagabond you shall be on the earth."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:13: Genesis 4:13 And Cain said to the LORD, "My punishment is greater than I can bear!(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:14: Genesis 4:14 Surely You have driven me out this day from the face of the ground; I shall be hidden from Your face; I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond on the earth, and it will happen that anyone who finds me will kill me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:15: Genesis 4:15 And the LORD said to him, "Therefore, whoever kills Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold." And the LORD set a mark on Cain, lest anyone finding him should kill him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:16: Genesis 4:16 Then Cain went out from the presence of the LORD and dwelt in the land of Nod on the east of Eden.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:17: Genesis 4:17 And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Ä’ Ìnoch. And he built a city, and called the name of the city after the name of his son"”Ä’ Ìnoch.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:18: Genesis 4:18 To Ä’ Ìnoch was born Irad; and Irad begot Mehujael, and Mehujael begot Methushael, and Methushael begot Lamech.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:19: Genesis 4:19 Then Lamech took for himself two wives: the name of one was Adah, and the name of the second was Zillah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:20: Genesis 4:20 And Adah bore Jabal. He was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:21: Genesis 4:21 His brother's name was Jubal. He was the father of all those who play the harp and flute.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:22: Genesis 4:22 And as for Zillah, she also bore Tubal-Cain, an instructor of every craftsman in bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal-Cain was Naamah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:23: Genesis 4:23 Then Lamech said to his wives: "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; Wives of Lamech, listen to my speech! For I have killed a man for wounding me, Even a young man for hurting me.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:24: Genesis 4:24 If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Then Lamech seventy-sevenfold."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:25: Genesis 4:25 And Adam knew his wife again, and she bore a son and named him Seth, "For God has appointed another seed for me instead of Abel, whom Cain killed."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 4:26: Genesis 4:26 And as for Seth, to him also a son was born; and he named him Ä’ Ìnosh. Then men began to call on the name of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:1: Genesis 5:1 This is the book of the genealogy of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in the likeness of God.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:2: Genesis 5:2 He created them male and female, and blessed them and called them Mankind in the day they were created.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:3: Genesis 5:3 And Adam lived one hundred and thirty years, and begot a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:4: Genesis 5:4 After he begot Seth, the days of Adam were eight hundred years; and he had sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:5: Genesis 5:5 So all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years; and he died.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:6: Genesis 5:6 Seth lived one hundred and five years, and begot Enosh.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:7: Genesis 5:7 After he begot Enosh, Seth lived eight hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:8: Genesis 5:8 So all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years; and he died.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:9: Genesis 5:9 Enosh lived ninety years, and begot Cainan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:10: Genesis 5:10 After he begot Cainan, Enosh lived eight hundred and fifteen years, and had sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:11: Genesis 5:11 So all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years; and he died.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:12: Genesis 5:12 Cainan lived seventy years, and begot Mahalalel.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:13: Genesis 5:13 After he begot Mahalalel, Cainan lived eight hundred and forty years, and had sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:14: Genesis 5:14 So all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years; and he died.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:15: Genesis 5:15 Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and begot Jared.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:16: Genesis 5:16 After he begot Jared, Mahalalel lived eight hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:17: Genesis 5:17 So all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred and ninety-five years; and he died.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:18: Genesis 5:18 Jared lived one hundred and sixty-two years, and begot Enoch.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:19: Genesis 5:19 After he begot Enoch, Jared lived eight hundred years, and had sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:20: Genesis 5:20 So all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years; and he died.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:21: Genesis 5:21 Enoch lived sixty-five years, and begot Methuselah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:22: Genesis 5:22 After he begot Methuselah, Enoch walked with God three hundred years, and had sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:23: Genesis 5:23 So all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:24: Genesis 5:24 And Enoch walked with God; and he was not, for God took him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:25: Genesis 5:25 Methuselah lived one hundred and eighty-seven years, and begot Lamech.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:26: Genesis 5:26 After he begot Lamech, Methuselah lived seven hundred and eighty-two years, and had sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:27: Genesis 5:27 So all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred and sixty-nine years; and he died.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:28: Genesis 5:28 Lamech lived one hundred and eighty-two years, and had a son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:29: Genesis 5:29 And he called his name Noah, saying, "This one will comfort us concerning our work and the toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD has cursed."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:30: Genesis 5:30 After he begot Noah, Lamech lived five hundred and ninety-five years, and had sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:31: Genesis 5:31 So all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy-seven years; and he died.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 5:32: Genesis 5:32 And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah begot Shem, Ham, and Japheth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:1: Genesis 6:1 Now it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born to them,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:2: Genesis 6:2 that the sons of God saw the daughters of men, that they were beautiful; and they took wives for themselves of all whom they chose.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:3: Genesis 6:3 And the LORD said, "My Spirit shall not strive with man forever, for he is indeed flesh; yet his days shall be one hundred and twenty years."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:4: Genesis 6:4 There were giants on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of men and they bore children to them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:5: Genesis 6:5 Then the LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every intent of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:6: Genesis 6:6 And the LORD was sorry that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:7: Genesis 6:7 So the LORD said, "I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth, both man and beast, creeping thing and birds of the air, for I am sorry that I have made them."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:8: Genesis 6:8 But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:9: Genesis 6:9 This is the genealogy of Noah. Noah was a just man, perfect in his generations. Noah walked with God.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:10: Genesis 6:10 And Noah begot three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:11: Genesis 6:11 The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:12: Genesis 6:12 So God looked upon the earth, and indeed it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:13: Genesis 6:13 And God said to Noah, "The end of all flesh has come before Me, for the earth is filled with violence through them; and behold, I will destroy them with the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:14: Genesis 6:14 Make yourself an ark of gopherwood; make rooms in the ark, and cover it inside and outside with pitch.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:15: Genesis 6:15 And this is how you shall make it: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:16: Genesis 6:16 You shall make a window for the ark, and you shall finish it to a cubit from above; and set the door of the ark in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third decks.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:17: Genesis 6:17 And behold, I Myself am bringing floodwaters on the earth, to destroy from under heaven all flesh in which is the breath of life; everything that is on the earth shall die.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:18: Genesis 6:18 But I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall go into the ark"”you, your sons, your wife, and your sons' wives with you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:19: Genesis 6:19 And of every living thing of all flesh you shall bring two of every sort into the ark, to keep them alive with you; they shall be male and female.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:20: Genesis 6:20 Of the birds after their kind, of animals after their kind, and of every creeping thing of the earth after its kind, two of every kind will come to you to keep them alive.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:21: Genesis 6:21 And you shall take for yourself of all food that is eaten, and you shall gather it to yourself; and it shall be food for you and for them."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 6:22: Genesis 6:22 Thus Noah did; according to all that God commanded him, so he did.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:1: Genesis 7:1 Then the LORD said to Noah, "Come into the ark, you and all your household, because I have seen that you are righteous before Me in this generation.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:2: Genesis 7:2 You shall take with you seven each of every clean animal, a male and his female; two each of animals that are unclean, a male and his female;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:3: Genesis 7:3 also seven each of birds of the air, male and female, to keep the species alive on the face of all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:4: Genesis 7:4 For after seven more days I will cause it to rain on the earth forty days and forty nights, and I will destroy from the face of the earth all living things that I have made."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:5: Genesis 7:5 And Noah did according to all that the LORD commanded him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:6: Genesis 7:6 Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters were on the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:7: Genesis 7:7 So Noah, with his sons, his wife, and his sons' wives, went into the ark because of the waters of the flood.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:8: Genesis 7:8 Of clean animals, of animals that are unclean, of birds, and of everything that creeps on the earth,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:9: Genesis 7:9 two by two they went into the ark to Noah, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:10: Genesis 7:10 And it came to pass after seven days that the waters of the flood were on the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:11: Genesis 7:11 In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:12: Genesis 7:12 And the rain was on the earth forty days and forty nights.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:13: Genesis 7:13 On the very same day Noah and Noah's sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and Noah's wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered the ark"”(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:14: Genesis 7:14 they and every beast after its kind, all cattle after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:15: Genesis 7:15 And they went into the ark to Noah, two by two, of all flesh in which is the breath of life.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:16: Genesis 7:16 So those that entered, male and female of all flesh, went in as God had commanded him; and the LORD shut him in.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:17: Genesis 7:17 Now the flood was on the earth forty days. The waters increased and lifted up the ark, and it rose high above the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:18: Genesis 7:18 The waters prevailed and greatly increased on the earth, and the ark moved about on the surface of the waters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:19: Genesis 7:19 And the waters prevailed exceedingly on the earth, and all the high hills under the whole heaven were covered.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:20: Genesis 7:20 The waters prevailed fifteen cubits upward, and the mountains were covered.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:21: Genesis 7:21 And all flesh died that moved on the earth: birds and cattle and beasts and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:22: Genesis 7:22 All in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, all that was on the dry land, died.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:23: Genesis 7:23 So He destroyed all living things which were on the face of the ground: both man and cattle, creeping thing and bird of the air. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah and those who were with him in the ark remained alive.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 7:24: Genesis 7:24 And the waters prevailed on the earth one hundred and fifty days.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:1: Genesis 8:1 Then God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the animals that were with him in the ark. And God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters subsided.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:2: Genesis 8:2 The fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were also stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:3: Genesis 8:3 And the waters receded continually from the earth. At the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters decreased.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:4: Genesis 8:4 Then the ark rested in the seventh month, the seventeenth day of the month, on the mountains of Ararat.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:5: Genesis 8:5 And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were seen.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:6: Genesis 8:6 So it came to pass, at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:7: Genesis 8:7 Then he sent out a raven, which kept going to and fro until the waters had dried up from the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:8: Genesis 8:8 He also sent out from himself a dove, to see if the waters had receded from the face of the ground.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:9: Genesis 8:9 But the dove found no resting place for the sole of her foot, and she returned into the ark to him, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth. So he put out his hand and took her, and drew her into the ark to himself.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:10: Genesis 8:10 And he waited yet another seven days, and again he sent the dove out from the ark.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:11: Genesis 8:11 Then the dove came to him in the evening, and behold, a freshly plucked olive leaf was in her mouth; and Noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:12: Genesis 8:12 So he waited yet another seven days and sent out the dove, which did not return again to him anymore.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:13: Genesis 8:13 And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, that the waters were dried up from the earth; and Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked, and indeed the surface of the ground was dry.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:14: Genesis 8:14 And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dried.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:15: Genesis 8:15 Then God spoke to Noah, saying,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:16: Genesis 8:16 "Go out of the ark, you and your wife, and your sons and your sons' wives with you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:17: Genesis 8:17 Bring out with you every living thing of all flesh that is with you: birds and cattle and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, so that they may abound on the earth, and be fruitful and multiply on the earth."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:18: Genesis 8:18 So Noah went out, and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:19: Genesis 8:19 Every animal, every creeping thing, every bird, and whatever creeps on the earth, according to their families, went out of the ark.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:20: Genesis 8:20 Then Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:21: Genesis 8:21 And the LORD smelled a soothing aroma. Then the LORD said in His heart, "I will never again curse the ground for man's sake, although the imagination of man's heart is evil from his youth; nor will I again destroy every living thing as I have done.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 8:22: Genesis 8:22 "While the earth remains, Seedtime and harvest, Cold and heat, Winter and summer, And day and night Shall not cease."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:1: Genesis 9:1 So God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them: "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:2: Genesis 9:2 And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be on every beast of the earth, on every bird of the air, on all that move on the earth, and on all the fish of the sea. They are given into your hand.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:3: Genesis 9:3 Every moving thing that lives shall be food for you. I have given you all things, even as the green herbs.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:4: Genesis 9:4 But you shall not eat flesh with its life, that is, its blood.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:5: Genesis 9:5 Surely for your lifeblood I will demand a reckoning; from the hand of every beast I will require it, and from the hand of man. From the hand of every man's brother I will require the life of man.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:6: Genesis 9:6 "Whoever sheds man's blood, By man his blood shall be shed;  For in the image of God He made man.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:7: Genesis 9:7 And as for you, be fruitful and multiply; Bring forth abundantly in the earth And multiply in it."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:8: Genesis 9:8 Then God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:9: Genesis 9:9 "And as for Me, behold, I establish My covenant with you and with your descendants after you,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:10: Genesis 9:10 and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the cattle, and every beast of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ark, every beast of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:11: Genesis 9:11 Thus I establish My covenant with you: Never again shall all flesh be cut off by the waters of the flood; never again shall there be a flood to destroy the earth."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:12: Genesis 9:12 And God said: "This is the sign of the covenant which I make between Me and you, and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:13: Genesis 9:13 I set My rainbow in the cloud, and it shall be for the sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:14: Genesis 9:14 It shall be, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow shall be seen in the cloud;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:15: Genesis 9:15 and I will remember My covenant which is between Me and you and every living creature of all flesh; the waters shall never again become a flood to destroy all flesh.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:16: Genesis 9:16 The rainbow shall be in the cloud, and I will look on it to remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:17: Genesis 9:17 And God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that is on the earth."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:18: Genesis 9:18 Now the sons of Noah who went out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:19: Genesis 9:19 These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:20: Genesis 9:20 And Noah began to be a farmer, and he planted a vineyard.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:21: Genesis 9:21 Then he drank of the wine and was drunk, and became uncovered in his tent.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:22: Genesis 9:22 And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:23: Genesis 9:23 But Shem and Japheth took a garment, laid it on both their shoulders, and went backward and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were turned away, and they did not see their father's nakedness.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:24: Genesis 9:24 So Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done to him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:25: Genesis 9:25 Then he said:  "Cursed be Canaan; A servant of servants He shall be to his brethren."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:26: Genesis 9:26 And he said:  "Blessed be the LORD, The God of Shem, And may Canaan be his servant.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:27: Genesis 9:27 May God enlarge Japheth,  And may he dwell in the tents of Shem; And may Canaan be his servant."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:28: Genesis 9:28 And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 9:29: Genesis 9:29 So all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years; and he died.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:1: Genesis 10:1 Now this is the genealogy of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:2: Genesis 10:2 The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:3: Genesis 10:3 The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:4: Genesis 10:4 The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:5: Genesis 10:5 From these the coastland peoples of the Gentiles were separated into their lands, everyone according to his language, according to their families, into their nations.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:6: Genesis 10:6 The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:7: Genesis 10:7 The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabtechah; and the sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:8: Genesis 10:8 Cush begot Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:9: Genesis 10:9 He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; therefore it is said, "Like Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:10: Genesis 10:10 And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:11: Genesis 10:11 From that land he went to Assyria and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:12: Genesis 10:12 and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (that is the principal city).(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:13: Genesis 10:13 Mizraim begot Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:14: Genesis 10:14 Pathrusim, and Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines and Caphtorim).(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:15: Genesis 10:15 Canaan begot Sidon his firstborn, and Heth;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:16: Genesis 10:16 the Jebusite, the Amorite, and the Girgashite;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:17: Genesis 10:17 the Hivite, the Arkite, and the Sinite;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:18: Genesis 10:18 the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were dispersed.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:19: Genesis 10:19 And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon as you go toward Gerar, as far as Gaza; then as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:20: Genesis 10:20 These were the sons of Ham, according to their families, according to their languages, in their lands and in their nations.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:21: Genesis 10:21 And children were born also to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:22: Genesis 10:22 The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:23: Genesis 10:23 The sons of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:24: Genesis 10:24 Arphaxad begot Salah, and Salah begot Eber.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:25: Genesis 10:25 To Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:26: Genesis 10:26 Joktan begot Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:29: Genesis 10:29 Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:30: Genesis 10:30 And their dwelling place was from Mesha as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:31: Genesis 10:31 These were the sons of Shem, according to their families, according to their languages, in their lands, according to their nations.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 10:32: Genesis 10:32 These were the families of the sons of Noah, according to their generations, in their nations; and from these the nations were divided on the earth after the flood.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:1: Genesis 11:1 Now the whole earth had one language and one speech.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:2: Genesis 11:2 And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they dwelt there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:3: Genesis 11:3 Then they said to one another, "Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly." They had brick for stone, and they had asphalt for mortar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:4: Genesis 11:4 And they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top is in the heavens; let us make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad over the face of the whole earth."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:5: Genesis 11:5 But the LORD came down to see the city and the tower which the sons of men had built.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:6: Genesis 11:6 And the LORD said, "Indeed the people are one and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do; now nothing that they propose to do will be withheld from them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:7: Genesis 11:7 Come, let Us go down and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another's speech."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:8: Genesis 11:8 So the LORD scattered them abroad from there over the face of all the earth, and they ceased building the city.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:9: Genesis 11:9 Therefore its name is called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth; and from there the LORD scattered them abroad over the face of all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:10: Genesis 11:10 This is the genealogy of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old, and begot Arphaxad two years after the flood.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:11: Genesis 11:11 After he begot Arphaxad, Shem lived five hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:12: Genesis 11:12 Arphaxad lived thirty-five years, and begot Salah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:13: Genesis 11:13 After he begot Salah, Arphaxad lived four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:14: Genesis 11:14 Salah lived thirty years, and begot Eber.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:15: Genesis 11:15 After he begot Eber, Salah lived four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:16: Genesis 11:16 Eber lived thirty-four years, and begot Peleg.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:17: Genesis 11:17 After he begot Peleg, Eber lived four hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:18: Genesis 11:18 Peleg lived thirty years, and begot Reu.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:19: Genesis 11:19 After he begot Reu, Peleg lived two hundred and nine years, and begot sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:20: Genesis 11:20 Reu lived thirty-two years, and begot Serug.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:21: Genesis 11:21 After he begot Serug, Reu lived two hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:22: Genesis 11:22 Serug lived thirty years, and begot Nahor.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:23: Genesis 11:23 After he begot Nahor, Serug lived two hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:24: Genesis 11:24 Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and begot Terah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:25: Genesis 11:25 After he begot Terah, Nahor lived one hundred and nineteen years, and begot sons and daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:26: Genesis 11:26 Now Terah lived seventy years, and begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:27: Genesis 11:27 This is the genealogy of Terah: Terah begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran begot Lot.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:28: Genesis 11:28 And Haran died before his father Terah in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldeans.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:29: Genesis 11:29 Then Abram and Nahor took wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran the father of Milcah and the father of Iscah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:30: Genesis 11:30 But  Sarai was barren; she had no child.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:31: Genesis 11:31 And Terah took his son Abram and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, his son Abram's wife, and they went out with them from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to the land of Canaan; and they came to Haran and dwelt there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 11:32: Genesis 11:32 So the days of Terah were two hundred and five years, and Terah died in Haran.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:1: Genesis 12:1 Now the LORD had said to Abram: "Get out of your country, From your family And from your father's house, To a land that I will show you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:2: Genesis 12:2 I will make you a great nation;  I will bless you And make your name great;  And you shall be a blessing.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:3: Genesis 12:3 I will bless those who bless you, And I will curse him who curses you; And in you all the families of the earth shall be blessed."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:4: Genesis 12:4 So Abram departed as the LORD had spoken to him, and Lot went with him. And Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:5: Genesis 12:5 Then Abram took Sarai his wife and Lot his brother's son, and all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they departed to go to the land of Canaan. So they came to the land of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:6: Genesis 12:6 Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, as far as the terebinth tree of Moreh. And the Canaanites were then in the land.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:7: Genesis 12:7 Then the LORD appeared to Abram and said, "To your descendants I will give this land." And there he built an altar to the LORD, who had appeared to him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:8: Genesis 12:8 And he moved from there to the mountain east of Bethel, and he pitched his tent with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east; there he built an altar to the LORD and called on the name of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:9: Genesis 12:9 So Abram journeyed, going on still toward the South.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:10: Genesis 12:10 Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to dwell there, for the famine was severe in the land.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:11: Genesis 12:11 And it came to pass, when he was close to entering Egypt, that he said to Sarai his wife, "Indeed I know that you are a woman of beautiful countenance.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:12: Genesis 12:12 Therefore it will happen, when the Egyptians see you, that they will say, "˜This is his wife'; and they will kill me, but they will let you live.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:13: Genesis 12:13 Please say you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that I may live because of you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:14: Genesis 12:14 So it was, when Abram came into Egypt, that the Egyptians saw the woman, that she was very beautiful.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:15: Genesis 12:15 The princes of Pharaoh also saw her and commended her to Pharaoh. And the woman was taken to Pharaoh's house.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:16: Genesis 12:16 He treated Abram well for her sake. He had sheep, oxen, male donkeys, male and female servants, female donkeys, and camels.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:17: Genesis 12:17 But the LORD plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram's wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:18: Genesis 12:18 And Pharaoh called Abram and said, "What is this you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:19: Genesis 12:19 Why did you say, "˜She is my sister'? I might have taken her as my wife. Now therefore, here is your wife; take her and go your way."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 12:20: Genesis 12:20 So Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him; and they sent him away, with his wife and all that he had.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:1: Genesis 13:1 Then Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all that he had, and Lot with him, to the South.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:2: Genesis 13:2 Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:3: Genesis 13:3 And he went on his journey from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:4: Genesis 13:4 to the place of the altar which he had made there at first. And there Abram called on the name of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:5: Genesis 13:5 Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks and herds and tents.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:6: Genesis 13:6 Now the land was not able to support them, that they might dwell together, for their possessions were so great that they could not dwell together.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:7: Genesis 13:7 And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram's livestock and the herdsmen of Lot's livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites then dwelt in the land.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:8: Genesis 13:8 So Abram said to Lot, "Please let there be no strife between you and me, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen; for we are brethren.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:9: Genesis 13:9 Is not the whole land before you? Please separate from me. If you take the left, then I will go to the right; or, if you go to the right, then I will go to the left."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:10: Genesis 13:10 And Lot lifted his eyes and saw all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered everywhere (before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah) like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt as you go toward Zoar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:11: Genesis 13:11 Then Lot chose for himself all the plain of Jordan, and Lot journeyed east. And they separated from each other.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:12: Genesis 13:12 Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the plain and pitched his tent even as far as Sodom.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:13: Genesis 13:13 But the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinful against the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:14: Genesis 13:14 And the LORD said to Abram, after Lot had separated from him: "Lift your eyes now and look from the place where you are"” northward, southward, eastward, and westward;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:15: Genesis 13:15 for all the land which you see I give to you and your descendants forever.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:16: Genesis 13:16 And I will make your descendants as the dust of the earth; so that if a man could number the dust of the earth, then your descendants also could be numbered.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:17: Genesis 13:17 Arise, walk in the land through its length and its width, for I give it to you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 13:18: Genesis 13:18 Then Abram moved his tent, and went and dwelt by the terebinth trees of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:1: Genesis 14:1 And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:2: Genesis 14:2 that they made war with Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:3: Genesis 14:3 All these joined together in the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea).(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:4: Genesis 14:4 Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:5: Genesis 14:5 In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him came and attacked the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:6: Genesis 14:6 and the Horites in their mountain of Seir, as far as El Paran, which is by the wilderness.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:7: Genesis 14:7 Then they turned back and came to En Mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and attacked all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites who dwelt in Hazezon Tamar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:8: Genesis 14:8 And the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) went out and joined together in battle in the Valley of Siddim(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:9: Genesis 14:9 against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of nations, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar"”four kings against five.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:10: Genesis 14:10 Now the Valley of Siddim was full of asphalt pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled; some fell there, and the remainder fled to the mountains.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:11: Genesis 14:11 Then they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their provisions, and went their way.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:12: Genesis 14:12 They also took Lot, Abram's brother's son who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:13: Genesis 14:13 Then one who had escaped came and told Abram the Hebrew, for he dwelt by the terebinth trees of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner; and they were allies with Abram.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:14: Genesis 14:14 Now when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his three hundred and eighteen trained servants who were born in his own house, and went in pursuit as far as Dan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:15: Genesis 14:15 He divided his forces against them by night, and he and his servants attacked them and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is north of Damascus.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:16: Genesis 14:16 So he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot and his goods, as well as the women and the people.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:17: Genesis 14:17 And the king of Sodom went out to meet him at the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King's Valley), after his return from the defeat of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:18: Genesis 14:18 Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine; he was the priest of God Most High.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:19: Genesis 14:19 And he blessed him and said:  "Blessed be Abram of God Most High,  Possessor of heaven and earth;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:20: Genesis 14:20 And blessed be God Most High, Who has delivered your enemies into your hand."  And he gave him a tithe of all.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:21: Genesis 14:21 Now the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the persons, and take the goods for yourself."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:22: Genesis 14:22 But Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I have raised my hand to the LORD, God Most High, the Possessor of heaven and earth,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:23: Genesis 14:23 that I will take nothing, from a thread to a sandal strap, and that I will not take anything that is yours, lest you should say, "˜I have made Abram rich'"”(NKJV)
verses.genesis 14:24: Genesis 14:24 except only what the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:1: Genesis 15:1 After these things the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision, saying, "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:2: Genesis 15:2 But Abram said, "Lord GOD, what will You give me, seeing I go childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:3: Genesis 15:3 Then Abram said, "Look, You have given me no offspring; indeed one born in my house is my heir!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:4: Genesis 15:4 And behold, the word of the LORD came to him, saying, "This one shall not be your heir, but one who will come from your own body shall be your heir."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:5: Genesis 15:5 Then He brought him outside and said, "Look now toward heaven, and count the stars if you are able to number them." And He said to him, "So shall your descendants be."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:6: Genesis 15:6 And he believed in the LORD, and He accounted it to him for righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:7: Genesis 15:7 Then He said to him, "I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans, to give you this land to inherit it."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:8: Genesis 15:8 And he said, "Lord GOD, how shall I know that I will inherit it?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:9: Genesis 15:9 So He said to him, "Bring Me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:10: Genesis 15:10 Then he brought all these to Him and cut them in two, down the middle, and placed each piece opposite the other; but he did not cut the birds in two.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:11: Genesis 15:11 And when the vultures came down on the carcasses, Abram drove them away.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:12: Genesis 15:12 Now when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and behold, horror and great darkness fell upon him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:13: Genesis 15:13 Then He said to Abram: "Know certainly that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them, and they will afflict them four hundred years.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:14: Genesis 15:14 And also the nation whom they serve I will judge; afterward they shall come out with great possessions.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:15: Genesis 15:15 Now as for you, you shall go to your fathers in peace; you shall be buried at a good old age.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:16: Genesis 15:16 But in the fourth generation they shall return here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:17: Genesis 15:17 And it came to pass, when the sun went down and it was dark, that behold, there appeared a smoking oven and a burning torch that passed between those pieces.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:18: Genesis 15:18 On the same day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying:  "To your descendants I have given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the River Euphrates"”(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:19: Genesis 15:19 the Kenites, the Kenezzites, the Kadmonites,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:20: Genesis 15:20 the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 15:21: Genesis 15:21 the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:1: Genesis 16:1 Now Sarai, Abram's wife, had borne him no children. And she had an Egyptian maidservant whose name was Hagar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:2: Genesis 16:2 So Sarai said to Abram, "See now, the LORD has restrained me from bearing children. Please, go in to my maid; perhaps I shall obtain children by her." And Abram heeded the voice of Sarai.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:3: Genesis 16:3 Then Sarai, Abram's wife, took Hagar her maid, the Egyptian, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:4: Genesis 16:4 So he went in to Hagar, and she conceived. And when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress became despised in her eyes.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:5: Genesis 16:5 Then Sarai said to Abram, "My wrong be upon you! I gave my maid into your embrace; and when she saw that she had conceived, I became despised in her eyes. The LORD judge between you and me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:6: Genesis 16:6 So Abram said to Sarai, "Indeed your maid is in your hand; do to her as you please." And when Sarai dealt harshly with her, she fled from her presence.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:7: Genesis 16:7 Now the Angel of the LORD found her by a spring of water in the wilderness, by the spring on the way to Shur.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:8: Genesis 16:8 And He said, "Hagar, Sarai's maid, where have you come from, and where are you going?" She said, "I am fleeing from the presence of my mistress Sarai."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:9: Genesis 16:9 The Angel of the LORD said to her, "Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hand."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:10: Genesis 16:10 Then the Angel of the LORD said to her, "I will multiply your descendants exceedingly, so that they shall not be counted for multitude."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:11: Genesis 16:11 And the Angel of the LORD said to her: "Behold, you are with child,  And you shall bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, Because the LORD has heard your affliction.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:12: Genesis 16:12 He shall be a wild man; His hand shall be against every man, And every man's hand against him.  And he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:13: Genesis 16:13 Then she called the name of the LORD who spoke to her, You-Are-the-God-Who-Sees; for she said, "Have I also here seen Him who sees me?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:14: Genesis 16:14 Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi; observe, it is between Kadesh and Bered.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:15: Genesis 16:15 So Hagar bore Abram a son; and Abram named his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 16:16: Genesis 16:16 Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:1: Genesis 17:1 When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, "I am Almighty God; walk before Me and be blameless.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:2: Genesis 17:2 And I will make My covenant between Me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:3: Genesis 17:3 Then Abram fell on his face, and God talked with him, saying:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:4: Genesis 17:4 "As for Me, behold, My covenant is with you, and you shall be a father of many nations.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:5: Genesis 17:5 No longer shall your name be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham; for I have made you a father of many nations.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:6: Genesis 17:6 I will make you exceedingly fruitful; and I will make nations of you, and kings shall come from you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:7: Genesis 17:7 And I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you in their generations, for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and your descendants after you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:8: Genesis 17:8 Also I give to you and your descendants after you the land in which you are a stranger, all the land of Canaan, as an everlasting possession; and I will be their God."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:9: Genesis 17:9 And God said to Abraham: "As for you, you shall keep My covenant, you and your descendants after you throughout their generations.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:10: Genesis 17:10 This is My covenant which you shall keep, between Me and you and your descendants after you: Every male child among you shall be circumcised;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:11: Genesis 17:11 and you shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskins, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:12: Genesis 17:12 He who is eight days old among you shall be circumcised, every male child in your generations, he who is born in your house or bought with money from any foreigner who is not your descendant.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:13: Genesis 17:13 He who is born in your house and he who is bought with your money must be circumcised, and My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:14: Genesis 17:14 And the uncircumcised male child, who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that person shall be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:15: Genesis 17:15 Then God said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall be her name.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:16: Genesis 17:16 And I will bless her and also give you a son by her; then I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of peoples shall be from her."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:17: Genesis 17:17 Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and said in his heart, "Shall a child be born to a man who is one hundred years old? And shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear a child?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:18: Genesis 17:18 And Abraham said to God, "Oh, that Ishmael might live before You!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:19: Genesis 17:19 Then God said: "No, Sarah your wife shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac; I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his descendants after him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:20: Genesis 17:20 And as for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He shall beget twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:21: Genesis 17:21 But My covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this set time next year."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:22: Genesis 17:22 Then He finished talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:23: Genesis 17:23 So Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house and all who were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham's house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskins that very same day, as God had said to him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:24: Genesis 17:24 Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:25: Genesis 17:25 And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:26: Genesis 17:26 That very same day Abraham was circumcised, and his son Ishmael;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 17:27: Genesis 17:27 and all the men of his house, born in the house or bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:1: Genesis 18:1 Then the LORD appeared to him by the terebinth trees of Mamre, as he was sitting in the tent door in the heat of the day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:2: Genesis 18:2 So he lifted his eyes and looked, and behold, three men were standing by him; and when he saw them, he ran from the tent door to meet them, and bowed himself to the ground,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:3: Genesis 18:3 and said, "My Lord, if I have now found favor in Your sight, do not pass on by Your servant.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:4: Genesis 18:4 Please let a little water be brought, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:5: Genesis 18:5 And I will bring a morsel of bread, that you may refresh your hearts. After that you may pass by, inasmuch as you have come to your servant." They said, "Do as you have said."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:6: Genesis 18:6 So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah and said, "Quickly, make ready three measures of fine meal; knead it and make cakes."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:7: Genesis 18:7 And Abraham ran to the herd, took a tender and good calf, gave it to a young man, and he hastened to prepare it.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:8: Genesis 18:8 So he took butter and milk and the calf which he had prepared, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree as they ate.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:9: Genesis 18:9 Then they said to him, "Where is Sarah your wife?" So he said, "Here, in the tent."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:10: Genesis 18:10 And He said, "I will certainly return to you according to the time of life, and behold, Sarah your wife shall have a son." (Sarah was listening in the tent door which was behind him.)(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:11: Genesis 18:11 Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age; and Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:12: Genesis 18:12 Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, "After I have grown old, shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:13: Genesis 18:13 And the LORD said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh, saying, "˜Shall I surely bear a child, since I am old?'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:14: Genesis 18:14 Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the appointed time I will return to you, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:15: Genesis 18:15 But Sarah denied it, saying, "I did not laugh," for she was afraid. And He said, "No, but you did laugh!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:16: Genesis 18:16 Then the men rose from there and looked toward Sodom, and Abraham went with them to send them on the way.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:17: Genesis 18:17 And the LORD said, "Shall I hide from Abraham what I am doing,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:18: Genesis 18:18 since Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:19: Genesis 18:19 For I have known him, in order that he may command his children and his household after him, that they keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice, that the LORD may bring to Abraham what He has spoken to him."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:20: Genesis 18:20 And the LORD said, "Because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grave,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:21: Genesis 18:21 I will go down now and see whether they have done altogether according to the outcry against it that has come to Me; and if not, I will know."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:22: Genesis 18:22 Then the men turned away from there and went toward Sodom, but Abraham still stood before the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:23: Genesis 18:23 And Abraham came near and said, "Would You also destroy the righteous with the wicked?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:24: Genesis 18:24 Suppose there were fifty righteous within the city; would You also destroy the place and not spare it for the fifty righteous that were in it?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:25: Genesis 18:25 Far be it from You to do such a thing as this, to slay the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be as the wicked; far be it from You! Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:26: Genesis 18:26 So the LORD said, "If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sakes."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:27: Genesis 18:27 Then Abraham answered and said, "Indeed now, I who am but dust and ashes have taken it upon myself to speak to the Lord:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:28: Genesis 18:28 Suppose there were five less than the fifty righteous; would You destroy all of the city for lack of five?" So He said, "If I find there forty-five, I will not destroy it."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:29: Genesis 18:29 And he spoke to Him yet again and said, "Suppose there should be forty found there?" So He said, "I will not do it for the sake of forty."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:30: Genesis 18:30 Then he said, "Let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak: Suppose thirty should be found there?" So He said, "I will not do it if I find thirty there."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:31: Genesis 18:31 And he said, "Indeed now, I have taken it upon myself to speak to the Lord: Suppose twenty should be found there?" So He said, "I will not destroy it for the sake of twenty."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:32: Genesis 18:32 Then he said, "Let not the Lord be angry, and I will speak but once more: Suppose ten should be found there?"  And He said, "I will not destroy it for the sake of ten."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 18:33: Genesis 18:33 So the LORD went His way as soon as He had finished speaking with Abraham; and Abraham returned to his place.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:1: Genesis 19:1 Now the two angels came to Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gate of Sodom. When Lot saw them, he rose to meet them, and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:2: Genesis 19:2 And he said, "Here now, my lords, please turn in to your servant's house and spend the night, and wash your feet; then you may rise early and go on your way." And they said, "No, but we will spend the night in the open square."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:3: Genesis 19:3 But he insisted strongly; so they turned in to him and entered his house. Then he made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:4: Genesis 19:4 Now before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, both old and young, all the people from every quarter, surrounded the house.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:5: Genesis 19:5 And they called to Lot and said to him, "Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us that we may know them carnally."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:6: Genesis 19:6 So Lot went out to them through the doorway, shut the door behind him,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:7: Genesis 19:7 and said, "Please, my brethren, do not do so wickedly!(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:8: Genesis 19:8 See now, I have two daughters who have not known a man; please, let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them as you wish; only do nothing to these men, since this is the reason they have come under the shadow of my roof."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:9: Genesis 19:9 And they said, "Stand back!" Then they said, "This one came in to stay here, and he keeps acting as a judge; now we will deal worse with you than with them." So they pressed hard against the man Lot, and came near to break down the door.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:10: Genesis 19:10 But the men reached out their hands and pulled Lot into the house with them, and shut the door.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:11: Genesis 19:11 And they struck the men who were at the doorway of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they became weary trying to find the door.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:12: Genesis 19:12 Then the men said to Lot, "Have you anyone else here? Son-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city"” take them out of this place!(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:13: Genesis 19:13 For we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown great before the face of the LORD, and the LORD has sent us to destroy it."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:14: Genesis 19:14 So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who had married his daughters, and said, "Get up, get out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city!" But to his sons-in-law he seemed to be joking.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:15: Genesis 19:15 When the morning dawned, the angels urged Lot to hurry, saying, "Arise, take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the punishment of the city."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:16: Genesis 19:16 And while he lingered, the men took hold of his hand, his wife's hand, and the hands of his two daughters, the LORD being merciful to him, and they brought him out and set him outside the city.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:17: Genesis 19:17 So it came to pass, when they had brought them outside, that he said, "Escape for your life! Do not look behind you nor stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be destroyed."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:18: Genesis 19:18 Then Lot said to them, "Please, no, my lords!(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:19: Genesis 19:19 Indeed now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have increased your mercy which you have shown me by saving my life; but I cannot escape to the mountains, lest some evil overtake me and I die.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:20: Genesis 19:20 See now, this city is near enough to flee to, and it is a little one; please let me escape there (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:21: Genesis 19:21 And he said to him, "See, I have favored you concerning this thing also, in that I will not overthrow this city for which you have spoken.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:22: Genesis 19:22 Hurry, escape there. For I cannot do anything until you arrive there." Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:23: Genesis 19:23 The sun had risen upon the earth when Lot entered Zoar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:24: Genesis 19:24 Then the LORD rained brimstone and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah, from the LORD out of the heavens.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:25: Genesis 19:25 So He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and what grew on the ground.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:26: Genesis 19:26 But his wife looked back behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:27: Genesis 19:27 And Abraham went early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:28: Genesis 19:28 Then he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain; and he saw, and behold, the smoke of the land which went up like the smoke of a furnace.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:29: Genesis 19:29 And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when He overthrew the cities in which Lot had dwelt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:30: Genesis 19:30 Then Lot went up out of Zoar and dwelt in the mountains, and his two daughters were with him; for he was afraid to dwell in Zoar. And he and his two daughters dwelt in a cave.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:31: Genesis 19:31 Now the firstborn said to the younger, "Our father is old, and there is no man on the earth to come in to us as is the custom of all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:32: Genesis 19:32 Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve the lineage of our father."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:33: Genesis 19:33 So they made their father drink wine that night. And the firstborn went in and lay with her father, and he did not know when she lay down or when she arose.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:34: Genesis 19:34 It happened on the next day that the firstborn said to the younger, "Indeed I lay with my father last night; let us make him drink wine tonight also, and you go in and lie with him, that we may preserve the lineage of our father."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:35: Genesis 19:35 Then they made their father drink wine that night also. And the younger arose and lay with him, and he did not know when she lay down or when she arose.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:36: Genesis 19:36 Thus both the daughters of Lot were with child by their father.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:37: Genesis 19:37 The firstborn bore a son and called his name Moab; he is the father of the Moabites to this day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 19:38: Genesis 19:38 And the younger, she also bore a son and called his name Ben-Ammi; he is the father of the people of Ammon to this day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:1: Genesis 20:1 And Abraham journeyed from there to the South, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur, and stayed in Gerar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:2: Genesis 20:2 Now Abraham said of Sarah his wife, "She is my sister." And Abimelech king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.(NKJV)
