verses.genesis 20:3: Genesis 20:3 But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, "Indeed you are a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken, for she is a man's wife."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:4: Genesis 20:4 But Abimelech had not come near her; and he said, "Lord, will You slay a righteous nation also?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:5: Genesis 20:5 Did he not say to me, "˜She is my sister'? And she, even she herself said, "˜He is my brother.' In the integrity of my heart and innocence of my hands I have done this."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:6: Genesis 20:6 And God said to him in a dream, "Yes, I know that you did this in the integrity of your heart. For I also withheld you from sinning against Me; therefore I did not let you touch her.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:7: Genesis 20:7 Now therefore, restore the man's wife; for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you shall live. But if you do not restore her, know that you shall surely die, you and all who are yours."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:8: Genesis 20:8 So Abimelech rose early in the morning, called all his servants, and told all these things in their hearing; and the men were very much afraid.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:9: Genesis 20:9 And Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, "What have you done to us? How have I offended you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:10: Genesis 20:10 Then Abimelech said to Abraham, "What did you have in view, that you have done this thing?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:11: Genesis 20:11 And Abraham said, "Because I thought, surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will kill me on account of my wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:12: Genesis 20:12 But indeed she is truly my sister. She is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:13: Genesis 20:13 And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said to her, "˜This is your kindness that you should do for me: in every place, wherever we go, say of me, "He is my brother." ' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:14: Genesis 20:14 Then Abimelech took sheep, oxen, and male and female servants, and gave them to Abraham; and he restored Sarah his wife to him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:15: Genesis 20:15 And Abimelech said, "See, my land is before you; dwell where it pleases you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:16: Genesis 20:16 Then to Sarah he said, "Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver; indeed this vindicates you before all who are with you and before everybody." Thus she was rebuked.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:17: Genesis 20:17 So Abraham prayed to God; and God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants. Then they bore children;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 20:18: Genesis 20:18 for the LORD had closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:1: Genesis 21:1 And the LORD visited Sarah as He had said, and the LORD did for Sarah as He had spoken.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:2: Genesis 21:2 For Sarah conceived and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:3: Genesis 21:3 And Abraham called the name of his son who was born to him"”whom Sarah bore to him"” Isaac.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:4: Genesis 21:4 Then Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:5: Genesis 21:5 Now Abraham was one hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:6: Genesis 21:6 And Sarah said, "God has made me laugh, and all who hear will laugh with me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:7: Genesis 21:7 She also said, "Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:8: Genesis 21:8 So the child grew and was weaned. And Abraham made a great feast on the same day that Isaac was weaned.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:9: Genesis 21:9 And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, scoffing.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:10: Genesis 21:10 Therefore she said to Abraham, "Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, namely with Isaac."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:11: Genesis 21:11 And the matter was very displeasing in Abraham's sight because of his son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:12: Genesis 21:12 But God said to Abraham, "Do not let it be displeasing in your sight because of the lad or because of your bondwoman. Whatever Sarah has said to you, listen to her voice; for in Isaac your seed shall be called.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:13: Genesis 21:13 Yet I will also make a nation of the son of the bondwoman, because he is your seed."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:14: Genesis 21:14 So Abraham rose early in the morning, and took bread and a skin of water; and putting it on her shoulder, he gave it and the boy to Hagar, and sent her away. Then she departed and wandered in the Wilderness of Beersheba.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:15: Genesis 21:15 And the water in the skin was used up, and she placed the boy under one of the shrubs.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:16: Genesis 21:16 Then she went and sat down across from him at a distance of about a bowshot; for she said to herself, "Let me not see the death of the boy." So she sat opposite him, and lifted her voice and wept.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:17: Genesis 21:17 And God heard the voice of the lad. Then the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said to her, "What ails you, Hagar? Fear not, for God has heard the voice of the lad where he is.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:18: Genesis 21:18 Arise, lift up the lad and hold him with your hand, for I will make him a great nation."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:19: Genesis 21:19 Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. And she went and filled the skin with water, and gave the lad a drink.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:20: Genesis 21:20 So God was with the lad; and he grew and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:21: Genesis 21:21 He dwelt in the Wilderness of Paran; and his mother took a wife for him from the land of Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:22: Genesis 21:22 And it came to pass at that time that Abimelech and Phichol, the commander of his army, spoke to Abraham, saying, "God is with you in all that you do.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:23: Genesis 21:23 Now therefore, swear to me by God that you will not deal falsely with me, with my offspring, or with my posterity; but that according to the kindness that I have done to you, you will do to me and to the land in which you have dwelt."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:24: Genesis 21:24 And Abraham said, "I will swear."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:25: Genesis 21:25 Then Abraham rebuked Abimelech because of a well of water which Abimelech's servants had seized.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:26: Genesis 21:26 And Abimelech said, "I do not know who has done this thing; you did not tell me, nor had I heard of it until today."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:27: Genesis 21:27 So Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two of them made a covenant.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:28: Genesis 21:28 And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:29: Genesis 21:29 Then Abimelech asked Abraham, "What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:30: Genesis 21:30 And he said, "You will take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that they may be my witness that I have dug this well."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:31: Genesis 21:31 Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because the two of them swore an oath there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:32: Genesis 21:32 Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba. So Abimelech rose with Phichol, the commander of his army, and they returned to the land of the Philistines.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:33: Genesis 21:33 Then Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 21:34: Genesis 21:34 And Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines many days.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:1: Genesis 22:1 Now it came to pass after these things that God tested Abraham, and said to him, "Abraham!" And he said, "Here I am."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:2: Genesis 22:2 Then He said, "Take now your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I shall tell you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:3: Genesis 22:3 So Abraham rose early in the morning and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son; and he split the wood for the burnt offering, and arose and went to the place of which God had told him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:4: Genesis 22:4 Then on the third day Abraham lifted his eyes and saw the place afar off.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:5: Genesis 22:5 And Abraham said to his young men, "Stay here with the donkey; the lad and I will go yonder and worship, and we will come back to you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:6: Genesis 22:6 So Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife, and the two of them went together.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:7: Genesis 22:7 But Isaac spoke to Abraham his father and said, "My father!" And he said, "Here I am, my son." Then he said, "Look, the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:8: Genesis 22:8 And Abraham said, "My son, God will provide for Himself the lamb for a burnt offering." So the two of them went together.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:9: Genesis 22:9 Then they came to the place of which God had told him. And Abraham built an altar there and placed the wood in order; and he bound Isaac his son and laid him on the altar, upon the wood.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:10: Genesis 22:10 And Abraham stretched out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:11: Genesis 22:11 But the Angel of the LORD called to him from heaven and said, "Abraham, Abraham!" So he said, "Here I am."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:12: Genesis 22:12 And He said, "Do not lay your hand on the lad, or do anything to him; for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from Me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:13: Genesis 22:13 Then Abraham lifted his eyes and looked, and there behind him was a ram caught in a thicket by its horns. So Abraham went and took the ram, and offered it up for a burnt offering instead of his son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:14: Genesis 22:14 And Abraham called the name of the place, The-LORD-Will-Provide; as it is said to this day, "In the Mount of the LORD it shall be provided."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:15: Genesis 22:15 Then the Angel of the LORD called to Abraham a second time out of heaven,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:16: Genesis 22:16 and said: "By Myself I have sworn, says the LORD, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son"”(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:17: Genesis 22:17 blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply your descendants as the stars of the heaven and as the sand which is on the seashore; and your descendants shall possess the gate of their enemies.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:18: Genesis 22:18 In your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:19: Genesis 22:19 So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:20: Genesis 22:20 Now it came to pass after these things that it was told Abraham, saying, "Indeed Milcah also has borne children to your brother Nahor:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:21: Genesis 22:21 Huz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:22: Genesis 22:22 Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:23: Genesis 22:23 And Bethuel begot Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham's brother.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 22:24: Genesis 22:24 His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Thahash, and Maachah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:1: Genesis 23:1 Sarah lived one hundred and twenty-seven years; these were the years of the life of Sarah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:2: Genesis 23:2 So Sarah died in Kirjath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah and to weep for her.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:3: Genesis 23:3 Then Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:4: Genesis 23:4 "I am a foreigner and a visitor among you. Give me property for a burial place among you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:5: Genesis 23:5 And the sons of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:6: Genesis 23:6 "Hear us, my lord: You are a mighty prince among us; bury your dead in the choicest of our burial places. None of us will withhold from you his burial place, that you may bury your dead."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:7: Genesis 23:7 Then Abraham stood up and bowed himself to the people of the land, the sons of Heth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:8: Genesis 23:8 And he spoke with them, saying, "If it is your wish that I bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and meet with Ephron the son of Zohar for me,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:9: Genesis 23:9 that he may give me the cave of Machpelah which he has, which is at the end of his field. Let him give it to me at the full price, as property for a burial place among you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:10: Genesis 23:10 Now Ephron dwelt among the sons of Heth; and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the presence of the sons of Heth, all who entered at the gate of his city, saying,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:11: Genesis 23:11 "No, my lord, hear me: I give you the field and the cave that is in it; I give it to you in the presence of the sons of my people. I give it to you. Bury your dead!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:12: Genesis 23:12 Then Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:13: Genesis 23:13 and he spoke to Ephron in the hearing of the people of the land, saying, "If you will give it, please hear me. I will give you money for the field; take it from me and I will bury my dead there."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:14: Genesis 23:14 And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:15: Genesis 23:15 "My lord, listen to me; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver. What is that between you and me? So bury your dead."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:16: Genesis 23:16 And Abraham listened to Ephron; and Abraham weighed out the silver for Ephron which he had named in the hearing of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, currency of the merchants.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:17: Genesis 23:17 So the field of Ephron which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field and the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, which were within all the surrounding borders, were deeded(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:18: Genesis 23:18 to Abraham as a possession in the presence of the sons of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:19: Genesis 23:19 And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah, before Mamre (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 23:20: Genesis 23:20 So the field and the cave that is in it were deeded to Abraham by the sons of Heth as property for a burial place.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:1: Genesis 24:1 Now Abraham was old, well advanced in age; and the LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:2: Genesis 24:2 So Abraham said to the oldest servant of his house, who ruled over all that he had, "Please, put your hand under my thigh,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:3: Genesis 24:3 and I will make you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:4: Genesis 24:4 but you shall go to my country and to my family, and take a wife for my son Isaac."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:5: Genesis 24:5 And the servant said to him, "Perhaps the woman will not be willing to follow me to this land. Must I take your son back to the land from which you came?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:6: Genesis 24:6 But Abraham said to him, "Beware that you do not take my son back there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:7: Genesis 24:7 The LORD God of heaven, who took me from my father's house and from the land of my family, and who spoke to me and swore to me, saying, "˜To your descendants I give this land,' He will send His angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:8: Genesis 24:8 And if the woman is not willing to follow you, then you will be released from this oath; only do not take my son back there."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:9: Genesis 24:9 So the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:10: Genesis 24:10 Then the servant took ten of his master's camels and departed, for all his master's goods were in his hand. And he arose and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:11: Genesis 24:11 And he made his camels kneel down outside the city by a well of water at evening time, the time when women go out to draw water.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:12: Genesis 24:12 Then he said, "O LORD God of my master Abraham, please give me success this day, and show kindness to my master Abraham.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:13: Genesis 24:13 Behold, here I stand by the well of water, and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:14: Genesis 24:14 Now let it be that the young woman to whom I say, "˜Please let down your pitcher that I may drink,' and she says, "˜Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink'"”let her be the one You have appointed for Your servant Isaac. And by this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:15: Genesis 24:15 And it happened, before he had finished speaking, that behold, Rebekah, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, came out with her pitcher on her shoulder.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:16: Genesis 24:16 Now the young woman was very beautiful to behold, a virgin; no man had known her. And she went down to the well, filled her pitcher, and came up.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:17: Genesis 24:17 And the servant ran to meet her and said, "Please let me drink a little water from your pitcher."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:18: Genesis 24:18 So she said, "Drink, my lord." Then she quickly let her pitcher down to her hand, and gave him a drink.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:19: Genesis 24:19 And when she had finished giving him a drink, she said, "I will draw water for your camels also, until they have finished drinking."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:20: Genesis 24:20 Then she quickly emptied her pitcher into the trough, ran back to the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:21: Genesis 24:21 And the man, wondering at her, remained silent so as to know whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:22: Genesis 24:22 So it was, when the camels had finished drinking, that the man took a golden nose ring weighing half a shekel, and two bracelets for her wrists weighing ten shekels of gold,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:23: Genesis 24:23 and said, "Whose daughter are you? Tell me, please, is there room in your father's house for us to lodge?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:24: Genesis 24:24 So she said to him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, Milcah's son, whom she bore to Nahor."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:25: Genesis 24:25 Moreover she said to him, "We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:26: Genesis 24:26 Then the man bowed down his head and worshiped the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:27: Genesis 24:27 And he said, "Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken His mercy and His truth toward my master. As for me, being on the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:28: Genesis 24:28 So the young woman ran and told her mother's household these things.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:29: Genesis 24:29 Now Rebekah had a brother whose name was Laban, and Laban ran out to the man by the well.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:30: Genesis 24:30 So it came to pass, when he saw the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister's wrists, and when he heard the words of his sister Rebekah, saying, "Thus the man spoke to me," that he went to the man. And there he stood by the camels at the well.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:31: Genesis 24:31 And he said, "Come in, O blessed of the LORD! Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and a place for the camels."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:32: Genesis 24:32 Then the man came to the house. And he unloaded the camels, and provided straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:33: Genesis 24:33 Food was set before him to eat, but he said, "I will not eat until I have told about my errand." And he said, "Speak on."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:34: Genesis 24:34 So he said, "I am Abraham's servant.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:35: Genesis 24:35 The LORD has blessed my master greatly, and he has become great; and He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male and female servants, and camels and donkeys.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:36: Genesis 24:36 And Sarah my master's wife bore a son to my master when she was old; and to him he has given all that he has.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:37: Genesis 24:37 Now my master made me swear, saying, "˜You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:38: Genesis 24:38 but you shall go to my father's house and to my family, and take a wife for my son.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:39: Genesis 24:39 And I said to my master, "˜Perhaps the woman will not follow me.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:40: Genesis 24:40 But he said to me, "˜The LORD, before whom I walk, will send His angel with you and prosper your way; and you shall take a wife for my son from my family and from my father's house.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:41: Genesis 24:41 You will be clear from this oath when you arrive among my family; for if they will not give her to you, then you will be released from my oath.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:42: Genesis 24:42 "And this day I came to the well and said, "˜O LORD God of my master Abraham, if You will now prosper the way in which I go,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:43: Genesis 24:43 behold, I stand by the well of water; and it shall come to pass that when the virgin comes out to draw water, and I say to her, "Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:44: Genesis 24:44 and she says to me, "Drink, and I will draw for your camels also,""”let her be the woman whom the LORD has appointed for my master's son.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:45: Genesis 24:45 "But before I had finished speaking in my heart, there was Rebekah, coming out with her pitcher on her shoulder; and she went down to the well and drew water. And I said to her, "˜Please let me drink.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:46: Genesis 24:46 And she made haste and let her pitcher down from her shoulder, and said, "˜Drink, and I will give your camels a drink also.' So I drank, and she gave the camels a drink also.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:47: Genesis 24:47 Then I asked her, and said, "˜Whose daughter are you?' And she said, "˜The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor's son, whom Milcah bore to him.' So I put the nose ring on her nose and the bracelets on her wrists.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:48: Genesis 24:48 And I bowed my head and worshiped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the way of truth to take the daughter of my master's brother for his son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:49: Genesis 24:49 Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. And if not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand or to the left."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:50: Genesis 24:50 Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said, "The thing comes from the LORD; we cannot speak to you either bad or good.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:51: Genesis 24:51 Here is Rebekah before you; take her and go, and let her be your master's son's wife, as the LORD has spoken."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:52: Genesis 24:52 And it came to pass, when Abraham's servant heard their words, that he worshiped the LORD, bowing himself to the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:53: Genesis 24:53 Then the servant brought out jewelry of silver, jewelry of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and to her mother.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:54: Genesis 24:54 And he and the men who were with him ate and drank and stayed all night. Then they arose in the morning, and he said, "Send me away to my master."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:55: Genesis 24:55 But her brother and her mother said, "Let the young woman stay with us a few days, at least ten; after that she may go."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:56: Genesis 24:56 And he said to them, "Do not hinder me, since the LORD has prospered my way; send me away so that I may go to my master."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:57: Genesis 24:57 So they said, "We will call the young woman and ask her personally."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:58: Genesis 24:58 Then they called Rebekah and said to her, "Will you go with this man?" And she said, "I will go."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:59: Genesis 24:59 So they sent away Rebekah their sister and her nurse, and Abraham's servant and his men.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:60: Genesis 24:60 And they blessed Rebekah and said to her: "Our sister, may you become  The mother of thousands of ten thousands;   And may your descendants possess The gates of those who hate them."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:61: Genesis 24:61 Then Rebekah and her maids arose, and they rode on the camels and followed the man. So the servant took Rebekah and departed.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:62: Genesis 24:62 Now Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he dwelt in the South.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:63: Genesis 24:63 And Isaac went out to meditate in the field in the evening; and he lifted his eyes and looked, and there, the camels were coming.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:64: Genesis 24:64 Then Rebekah lifted her eyes, and when she saw Isaac she dismounted from her camel;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:65: Genesis 24:65 for she had said to the servant, "Who is this man walking in the field to meet us?" The servant said, "It is my master." So she took a veil and covered herself.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:66: Genesis 24:66 And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 24:67: Genesis 24:67 Then Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah's tent; and he took Rebekah and she became his wife, and he loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:1: Genesis 25:1 Abraham again took a wife, and her name was Keturah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:2: Genesis 25:2 And she bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:3: Genesis 25:3 Jokshan begot Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:4: Genesis 25:4 And the sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:5: Genesis 25:5 And Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:6: Genesis 25:6 But Abraham gave gifts to the sons of the concubines which Abraham had; and while he was still living he sent them eastward, away from Isaac his son, to the country of the east.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:7: Genesis 25:7 This is the sum of the years of Abraham's life which he lived: one hundred and seventy-five years.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:8: Genesis 25:8 Then Abraham breathed his last and died in a good old age, an old man and full of years, and was gathered to his people.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:9: Genesis 25:9 And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:10: Genesis 25:10 the field which Abraham purchased from the sons of Heth. There Abraham was buried, and Sarah his wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:11: Genesis 25:11 And it came to pass, after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac. And Isaac dwelt at Beer Lahai Roi.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:12: Genesis 25:12 Now this is the genealogy of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's maidservant, bore to Abraham.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:13: Genesis 25:13 And these were the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:15: Genesis 25:15 Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:16: Genesis 25:16 These were the sons of Ishmael and these were their names, by their towns and their settlements, twelve princes according to their nations.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:17: Genesis 25:17 These were the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred and thirty-seven years; and he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:18: Genesis 25:18 (They dwelt from Havilah as far as Shur, which is east of Egypt as you go toward Assyria.) He died in the presence of all his brethren.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:19: Genesis 25:19 This is the genealogy of Isaac, Abraham's son. Abraham begot Isaac.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:20: Genesis 25:20 Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah as wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:21: Genesis 25:21 Now Isaac pleaded with the LORD for his wife, because she was barren; and the LORD granted his plea, and Rebekah his wife conceived.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:22: Genesis 25:22 But the children struggled together within her; and she said, "If all is well, why am I like this?" So she went to inquire of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:23: Genesis 25:23 And the LORD said to her:  "Two nations are in your womb, Two peoples shall be separated from your body; One people shall be stronger than the other,  And the older shall serve the younger."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:24: Genesis 25:24 So when her days were fulfilled for her to give birth, indeed there were twins in her womb.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:25: Genesis 25:25 And the first came out red. He was like a hairy garment all over; so they called his name Esau.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:26: Genesis 25:26 Afterward his brother came out, and his hand took hold of Esau's heel; so his name was called Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:27: Genesis 25:27 So the boys grew. And Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field; but Jacob was a mild man, dwelling in tents.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:28: Genesis 25:28 And Isaac loved Esau because he ate of his game, but Rebekah loved Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:29: Genesis 25:29 Now Jacob cooked a stew; and Esau came in from the field, and he was weary.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:30: Genesis 25:30 And Esau said to Jacob, "Please feed me with that same red stew, for I am weary." Therefore his name was called Edom.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:31: Genesis 25:31 But Jacob said, "Sell me your birthright as of this day."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:32: Genesis 25:32 And Esau said, "Look, I am about to die; so what is this birthright to me?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:33: Genesis 25:33 Then Jacob said, "Swear to me as of this day." So he swore to him, and sold his birthright to Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 25:34: Genesis 25:34 And Jacob gave Esau bread and stew of lentils; then he ate and drank, arose, and went his way. Thus Esau despised his birthright.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:1: Genesis 26:1 There was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, in Gerar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:2: Genesis 26:2 Then the LORD appeared to him and said: "Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land of which I shall tell you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:3: Genesis 26:3 Dwell in this land, and I will be with you and bless you; for to you and your descendants I give all these lands, and I will perform the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:4: Genesis 26:4 And I will make your descendants multiply as the stars of heaven; I will give to your descendants all these lands; and in your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:5: Genesis 26:5 because Abraham obeyed My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:6: Genesis 26:6 So Isaac dwelt in Gerar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:7: Genesis 26:7 And the men of the place asked about his wife. And he said, "She is my sister"; for he was afraid to say, "She is my wife," because he thought, "lest the men of the place kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to behold."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:8: Genesis 26:8 Now it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked through a window, and saw, and there was Isaac, showing endearment to Rebekah his wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:9: Genesis 26:9 Then Abimelech called Isaac and said, "Quite obviously she is your wife; so how could you say, "˜She is my sister'?" Isaac said to him, "Because I said, "˜Lest I die on account of her.' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:10: Genesis 26:10 And Abimelech said, "What is this you have done to us? One of the people might soon have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:11: Genesis 26:11 So Abimelech charged all his people, saying, "He who touches this man or his wife shall surely be put to death."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:12: Genesis 26:12 Then Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year a hundredfold; and the LORD blessed him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:13: Genesis 26:13 The man began to prosper, and continued prospering until he became very prosperous;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:14: Genesis 26:14 for he had possessions of flocks and possessions of herds and a great number of servants. So the Philistines envied him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:15: Genesis 26:15 Now the Philistines had stopped up all the wells which his father's servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, and they had filled them with earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:16: Genesis 26:16 And Abimelech said to Isaac, "Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:17: Genesis 26:17 Then Isaac departed from there and pitched his tent in the Valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:18: Genesis 26:18 And Isaac dug again the wells of water which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them up after the death of Abraham. He called them by the names which his father had called them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:19: Genesis 26:19 Also Isaac's servants dug in the valley, and found a well of running water there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:20: Genesis 26:20 But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac's herdsmen, saying, "The water is ours." So he called the name of the well Esek, because they quarreled with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:21: Genesis 26:21 Then they dug another well, and they quarreled over that one also. So he called its name Sitnah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:22: Genesis 26:22 And he moved from there and dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it. So he called its name Rehoboth, because he said, "For now the LORD has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:23: Genesis 26:23 Then he went up from there to Beersheba.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:24: Genesis 26:24 And the LORD appeared to him the same night and said, "I am the God of your father Abraham; do not fear, for I am with you. I will bless you and multiply your descendants for My servant Abraham's sake."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:25: Genesis 26:25 So he built an altar there and called on the name of the LORD, and he pitched his tent there; and there Isaac's servants dug a well.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:26: Genesis 26:26 Then Abimelech came to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath, one of his friends, and Phichol the commander of his army.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:27: Genesis 26:27 And Isaac said to them, "Why have you come to me, since you hate me and have sent me away from you?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:28: Genesis 26:28 But they said, "We have certainly seen that the LORD is with you. So we said, "˜Let there now be an oath between us, between you and us; and let us make a covenant with you,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:29: Genesis 26:29 that you will do us no harm, since we have not touched you, and since we have done nothing to you but good and have sent you away in peace. You are now the blessed of the LORD.' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:30: Genesis 26:30 So he made them a feast, and they ate and drank.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:31: Genesis 26:31 Then they arose early in the morning and swore an oath with one another; and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:32: Genesis 26:32 It came to pass the same day that Isaac's servants came and told him about the well which they had dug, and said to him, "We have found water."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:33: Genesis 26:33 So he called it Shebah. Therefore the name of the city is Beersheba to this day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:34: Genesis 26:34 When Esau was forty years old, he took as wives Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 26:35: Genesis 26:35 And they were a grief of mind to Isaac and Rebekah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:1: Genesis 27:1 Now it came to pass, when Isaac was old and his eyes were so dim that he could not see, that he called Esau his older son and said to him, "My son." And he answered him, "Here I am."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:2: Genesis 27:2 Then he said, "Behold now, I am old. I do not know the day of my death.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:3: Genesis 27:3 Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field and hunt game for me.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:4: Genesis 27:4 And make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me that I may eat, that my soul may bless you before I die."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:5: Genesis 27:5 Now Rebekah was listening when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt game and to bring it.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:6: Genesis 27:6 So Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, "Indeed I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:7: Genesis 27:7 "˜Bring me game and make savory food for me, that I may eat it and bless you in the presence of the LORD before my death.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:8: Genesis 27:8 Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to what I command you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:9: Genesis 27:9 Go now to the flock and bring me from there two choice kids of the goats, and I will make savory food from them for your father, such as he loves.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:10: Genesis 27:10 Then you shall take it to your father, that he may eat it, and that he may bless you before his death."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:11: Genesis 27:11 And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, "Look, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth-skinned man.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:12: Genesis 27:12 Perhaps my father will feel me, and I shall seem to be a deceiver to him; and I shall bring a curse on myself and not a blessing."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:13: Genesis 27:13 But his mother said to him, "Let your curse be on me, my son; only obey my voice, and go, get them for me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:14: Genesis 27:14 And he went and got them and brought them to his mother, and his mother made savory food, such as his father loved.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:15: Genesis 27:15 Then Rebekah took the choice clothes of her elder son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob her younger son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:16: Genesis 27:16 And she put the skins of the kids of the goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:17: Genesis 27:17 Then she gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:18: Genesis 27:18 So he went to his father and said, "My father." And he said, "Here I am. Who are you, my son?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:19: Genesis 27:19 Jacob said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn; I have done just as you told me; please arise, sit and eat of my game, that your soul may bless me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:20: Genesis 27:20 But Isaac said to his son, "How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?" And he said, "Because the LORD your God brought it to me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:21: Genesis 27:21 Isaac said to Jacob, "Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:22: Genesis 27:22 So Jacob went near to Isaac his father, and he felt him and said, "The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:23: Genesis 27:23 And he did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like his brother Esau's hands; so he blessed him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:24: Genesis 27:24 Then he said, "Are you really my son Esau?" He said, "I am."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:25: Genesis 27:25 He said, "Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son's game, so that my soul may bless you." So he brought it near to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:26: Genesis 27:26 Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come near now and kiss me, my son."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:27: Genesis 27:27 And he came near and kissed him; and he smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him and said: "Surely, the smell of my son Is like the smell of a field Which the LORD has blessed.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:28: Genesis 27:28 Therefore may God give you Of the dew of heaven, Of the fatness of the earth, And plenty of grain and wine.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:29: Genesis 27:29 Let peoples serve you, And nations bow down to you. Be master over your brethren, And let your mother's sons bow down to you.  Cursed be everyone who curses you, And blessed be those who bless you!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:30: Genesis 27:30 Now it happened, as soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had scarcely gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:31: Genesis 27:31 He also had made savory food, and brought it to his father, and said to his father, "Let my father arise and eat of his son's game, that your soul may bless me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:32: Genesis 27:32 And his father Isaac said to him, "Who are you?" So he said, "I am your son, your firstborn, Esau."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:33: Genesis 27:33 Then Isaac trembled exceedingly, and said, "Who? Where is the one who hunted game and brought it to me? I ate all of it before you came, and I have blessed him"” and indeed he shall be blessed."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:34: Genesis 27:34 When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, "Bless me"”me also, O my father!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:35: Genesis 27:35 But he said, "Your brother came with deceit and has taken away your blessing."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:36: Genesis 27:36 And Esau said, "Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright, and now look, he has taken away my blessing!" And he said, "Have you not reserved a blessing for me?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:37: Genesis 27:37 Then Isaac answered and said to Esau, "Indeed I have made him your master, and all his brethren I have given to him as servants; with grain and wine I have sustained him. What shall I do now for you, my son?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:38: Genesis 27:38 And Esau said to his father, "Have you only one blessing, my father? Bless me"”me also, O my father!" And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:39: Genesis 27:39 Then Isaac his father answered and said to him: "Behold, your dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth, And of the dew of heaven from above.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:40: Genesis 27:40 By your sword you shall live, And you shall serve your brother; And it shall come to pass, when you become restless, That you shall break his yoke from your neck."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:41: Genesis 27:41 So Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him, and Esau said in his heart, "The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then I will kill my brother Jacob."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:42: Genesis 27:42 And the words of Esau her older son were told to Rebekah. So she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said to him, "Surely your brother Esau comforts himself concerning you by intending to kill you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:43: Genesis 27:43 Now therefore, my son, obey my voice: arise, flee to my brother Laban in Haran.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:44: Genesis 27:44 And stay with him a few days, until your brother's fury turns away,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:45: Genesis 27:45 until your brother's anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him; then I will send and bring you from there. Why should I be bereaved also of you both in one day?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 27:46: Genesis 27:46 And Rebekah said to Isaac, "I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth; if Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, like these who are the daughters of the land, what good will my life be to me?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:1: Genesis 28:1 Then Isaac called Jacob and blessed him, and charged him, and said to him: "You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:2: Genesis 28:2 Arise, go to Padan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother's father; and take yourself a wife from there of the daughters of Laban your mother's brother.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:3: Genesis 28:3 "May God Almighty bless you, And make you fruitful and multiply you, That you may be an assembly of peoples;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:4: Genesis 28:4 And give you the blessing of Abraham, To you and your descendants with you, That you may inherit the land  In which you are a stranger, Which God gave to Abraham."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:5: Genesis 28:5 So Isaac sent Jacob away, and he went to Padan Aram, to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:6: Genesis 28:6 Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Padan Aram to take himself a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, "You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan,"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:7: Genesis 28:7 and that Jacob had obeyed his father and his mother and had gone to Padan Aram.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:8: Genesis 28:8 Also Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan did not please his father Isaac.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:9: Genesis 28:9 So Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham's son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife in addition to the wives he had.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:10: Genesis 28:10 Now Jacob went out from Beersheba and went toward Haran.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:11: Genesis 28:11 So he came to a certain place and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. And he took one of the stones of that place and put it at his head, and he lay down in that place to sleep.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:12: Genesis 28:12 Then he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set up on the earth, and its top reached to heaven; and there the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:13: Genesis 28:13 And behold, the LORD stood above it and said: "I am the LORD God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac; the land on which you lie I will give to you and your descendants.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:14: Genesis 28:14 Also your descendants shall be as the dust of the earth; you shall spread abroad to the west and the east, to the north and the south; and in you and in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:15: Genesis 28:15 Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land; for I will not leave you until I have done what I have spoken to you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:16: Genesis 28:16 Then Jacob awoke from his sleep and said, "Surely the LORD is in this place, and I did not know it."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:17: Genesis 28:17 And he was afraid and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:18: Genesis 28:18 Then Jacob rose early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put at his head, set it up as a pillar, and poured oil on top of it.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:19: Genesis 28:19 And he called the name of that place Bethel; but the name of that city had been Luz previously.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:20: Genesis 28:20 Then Jacob made a vow, saying, "If God will be with me, and keep me in this way that I am going, and give me bread to eat and clothing to put on,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:21: Genesis 28:21 so that I come back to my father's house in peace, then the LORD shall be my God.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 28:22: Genesis 28:22 And this stone which I have set as a pillar shall be God's house, and of all that You give me I will surely give a tenth to You."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:1: Genesis 29:1 So Jacob went on his journey and came to the land of the people of the East.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:2: Genesis 29:2 And he looked, and saw a well in the field; and behold, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks. A large stone was on the well's mouth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:3: Genesis 29:3 Now all the flocks would be gathered there; and they would roll the stone from the well's mouth, water the sheep, and put the stone back in its place on the well's mouth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:4: Genesis 29:4 And Jacob said to them, "My brethren, where are you from?" And they said, "We are from Haran."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:5: Genesis 29:5 Then he said to them, "Do you know Laban the son of Nahor?" And they said, "We know him."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:6: Genesis 29:6 So he said to them, "Is he well?" And they said, "He is well. And look, his daughter Rachel is coming with the sheep."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:7: Genesis 29:7 Then he said, "Look, it is still high day; it is not time for the cattle to be gathered together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:8: Genesis 29:8 But they said, "We cannot until all the flocks are gathered together, and they have rolled the stone from the well's mouth; then we water the sheep."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:9: Genesis 29:9 Now while he was still speaking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep, for she was a shepherdess.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:10: Genesis 29:10 And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother's brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother's brother, that Jacob went near and rolled the stone from the well's mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother's brother.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:11: Genesis 29:11 Then Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice and wept.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:12: Genesis 29:12 And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father's relative and that he was Rebekah's son. So she ran and told her father.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:13: Genesis 29:13 Then it came to pass, when Laban heard the report about Jacob his sister's son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him and kissed him, and brought him to his house. So he told Laban all these things.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:14: Genesis 29:14 And Laban said to him, "Surely you are my bone and my flesh." And he stayed with him for a month.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:15: Genesis 29:15 Then Laban said to Jacob, "Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what should your wages be?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:16: Genesis 29:16 Now Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:17: Genesis 29:17 Leah's eyes were delicate, but Rachel was beautiful of form and appearance.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:18: Genesis 29:18 Now Jacob loved Rachel; so he said, "I will serve you seven years for Rachel your younger daughter."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:19: Genesis 29:19 And Laban said, "It is better that I give her to you than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:20: Genesis 29:20 So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, and they seemed only a few days to him because of the love he had for her.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:21: Genesis 29:21 Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:22: Genesis 29:22 And Laban gathered together all the men of the place and made a feast.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:23: Genesis 29:23 Now it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter and brought her to Jacob; and he went in to her.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:24: Genesis 29:24 And Laban gave his maid Zilpah to his daughter Leah as a maid.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:25: Genesis 29:25 So it came to pass in the morning, that behold, it was Leah. And he said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? Was it not for Rachel that I served you? Why then have you deceived me?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:26: Genesis 29:26 And Laban said, "It must not be done so in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:27: Genesis 29:27 Fulfill her week, and we will give you this one also for the service which you will serve with me still another seven years."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:28: Genesis 29:28 Then Jacob did so and fulfilled her week. So he gave him his daughter Rachel as wife also.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:29: Genesis 29:29 And Laban gave his maid Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as a maid.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:30: Genesis 29:30 Then Jacob also went in to Rachel, and he also loved Rachel more than Leah. And he served with Laban still another seven years.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:31: Genesis 29:31 When the LORD saw that Leah was unloved, He opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:32: Genesis 29:32 So Leah conceived and bore a son, and she called his name Reuben; for she said, "The LORD has surely looked on my affliction. Now therefore, my husband will love me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:33: Genesis 29:33 Then she conceived again and bore a son, and said, "Because the LORD has heard that I am unloved, He has therefore given me this son also." And she called his name Simeon.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:34: Genesis 29:34 She conceived again and bore a son, and said, "Now this time my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons." Therefore his name was called Levi.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 29:35: Genesis 29:35 And she conceived again and bore a son, and said, "Now I will praise the LORD." Therefore she called his name Judah. Then she stopped bearing.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:1: Genesis 30:1 Now when Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister, and said to Jacob, "Give me children, or else I die!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:2: Genesis 30:2 And Jacob's anger was aroused against Rachel, and he said, "Am I in the place of God, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:3: Genesis 30:3 So she said, "Here is my maid Bilhah; go in to her, and she will bear a child on my knees, that I also may have children by her."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:4: Genesis 30:4 Then she gave him Bilhah her maid as wife, and Jacob went in to her.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:5: Genesis 30:5 And Bilhah conceived and bore Jacob a son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:6: Genesis 30:6 Then Rachel said, "God has judged my case; and He has also heard my voice and given me a son." Therefore she called his name Dan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:7: Genesis 30:7 And Rachel's maid Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:8: Genesis 30:8 Then Rachel said, "With great wrestlings I have wrestled with my sister, and indeed I have prevailed." So she called his name Naphtali.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:9: Genesis 30:9 When Leah saw that she had stopped bearing, she took Zilpah her maid and gave her to Jacob as wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:10: Genesis 30:10 And Leah's maid Zilpah bore Jacob a son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:11: Genesis 30:11 Then Leah said, "A troop comes!" So she called his name Gad.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:12: Genesis 30:12 And Leah's maid Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:13: Genesis 30:13 Then Leah said, "I am happy, for the daughters will call me blessed." So she called his name Asher.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:14: Genesis 30:14 Now Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, "Please give me some of your son's mandrakes."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:15: Genesis 30:15 But she said to her, "Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son's mandrakes also?" And Rachel said, "Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son's mandrakes."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:16: Genesis 30:16 When Jacob came out of the field in the evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, "You must come in to me, for I have surely hired you with my son's mandrakes." And he lay with her that night.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:17: Genesis 30:17 And God listened to Leah, and she conceived and bore Jacob a fifth son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:18: Genesis 30:18 Leah said, "God has given me my wages, because I have given my maid to my husband." So she called his name Issachar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:19: Genesis 30:19 Then Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:20: Genesis 30:20 And Leah said, "God has endowed me with a good endowment; now my husband will dwell with me, because I have borne him six sons." So she called his name Zebulun.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:21: Genesis 30:21 Afterward she bore a daughter, and called her name Dinah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:22: Genesis 30:22 Then God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her and opened her womb.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:23: Genesis 30:23 And she conceived and bore a son, and said, "God has taken away my reproach."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:24: Genesis 30:24 So she called his name Joseph, and said, "The LORD shall add to me another son."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:25: Genesis 30:25 And it came to pass, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, "Send me away, that I may go to my own place and to my country.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:26: Genesis 30:26 Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service which I have done for you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:27: Genesis 30:27 And Laban said to him, "Please stay, if I have found favor in your eyes, for I have learned by experience that the LORD has blessed me for your sake."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:28: Genesis 30:28 Then he said, "Name me your wages, and I will give it."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:29: Genesis 30:29 So Jacob said to him, "You know how I have served you and how your livestock has been with me.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:30: Genesis 30:30 For what you had before I came was little, and it has increased to a great amount; the LORD has blessed you since my coming. And now, when shall I also provide for my own house?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:31: Genesis 30:31 So he said, "What shall I give you?" And Jacob said, "You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep your flocks:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:32: Genesis 30:32 Let me pass through all your flock today, removing from there all the speckled and spotted sheep, and all the brown ones among the lambs, and the spotted and speckled among the goats; and these shall be my wages.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:33: Genesis 30:33 So my righteousness will answer for me in time to come, when the subject of my wages comes before you: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the lambs, will be considered stolen, if it is with me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:34: Genesis 30:34 And Laban said, "Oh, that it were according to your word!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:35: Genesis 30:35 So he removed that day the male goats that were speckled and spotted, all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had some white in it, and all the brown ones among the lambs, and gave them into the hand of his sons.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:36: Genesis 30:36 Then he put three days' journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban's flocks.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:37: Genesis 30:37 Now Jacob took for himself rods of green poplar and of the almond and chestnut trees, peeled white strips in them, and exposed the white which was in the rods.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:38: Genesis 30:38 And the rods which he had peeled, he set before the flocks in the gutters, in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink, so that they should conceive when they came to drink.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:39: Genesis 30:39 So the flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks brought forth streaked, speckled, and spotted.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:40: Genesis 30:40 Then Jacob separated the lambs, and made the flocks face toward the streaked and all the brown in the flock of Laban; but he put his own flocks by themselves and did not put them with Laban's flock.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:41: Genesis 30:41 And it came to pass, whenever the stronger livestock conceived, that Jacob placed the rods before the eyes of the livestock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:42: Genesis 30:42 But when the flocks were feeble, he did not put them in; so the feebler were Laban's and the stronger Jacob's.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 30:43: Genesis 30:43 Thus the man became exceedingly prosperous, and had large flocks, female and male servants, and camels and donkeys.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:1: Genesis 31:1 Now Jacob heard the words of Laban's sons, saying, "Jacob has taken away all that was our father's, and from what was our father's he has acquired all this wealth."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:2: Genesis 31:2 And Jacob saw the countenance of Laban, and indeed it was not favorable toward him as before.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:3: Genesis 31:3 Then the LORD said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your fathers and to your family, and I will be with you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:4: Genesis 31:4 So Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field, to his flock,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:5: Genesis 31:5 and said to them, "I see your father's countenance, that it is not favorable toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:6: Genesis 31:6 And you know that with all my might I have served your father.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:7: Genesis 31:7 Yet your father has deceived me and changed my wages ten times, but God did not allow him to hurt me.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:8: Genesis 31:8 If he said thus: "˜The speckled shall be your wages,' then all the flocks bore speckled. And if he said thus: "˜The streaked shall be your wages,' then all the flocks bore streaked.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:9: Genesis 31:9 So God has taken away the livestock of your father and given them to me.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:10: Genesis 31:10 "And it happened, at the time when the flocks conceived, that I lifted my eyes and saw in a dream, and behold, the rams which leaped upon the flocks were streaked, speckled, and gray-spotted.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:11: Genesis 31:11 Then the Angel of God spoke to me in a dream, saying, "˜Jacob.' And I said, "˜Here I am.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:12: Genesis 31:12 And He said, "˜Lift your eyes now and see, all the rams which leap on the flocks are streaked, speckled, and gray-spotted; for I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:13: Genesis 31:13 I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar and where you made a vow to Me. Now arise, get out of this land, and return to the land of your family.' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:14: Genesis 31:14 Then Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, "Is there still any portion or inheritance for us in our father's house?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:15: Genesis 31:15 Are we not considered strangers by him? For he has sold us, and also completely consumed our money.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:16: Genesis 31:16 For all these riches which God has taken from our father are really ours and our children's; now then, whatever God has said to you, do it."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:17: Genesis 31:17 Then Jacob rose and set his sons and his wives on camels.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:18: Genesis 31:18 And he carried away all his livestock and all his possessions which he had gained, his acquired livestock which he had gained in Padan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:19: Genesis 31:19 Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and Rachel had stolen the household idols that were her father's.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:20: Genesis 31:20 And Jacob stole away, unknown to Laban the Syrian, in that he did not tell him that he intended to flee.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:21: Genesis 31:21 So he fled with all that he had. He arose and crossed the river, and headed toward the mountains of Gilead.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:22: Genesis 31:22 And Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:23: Genesis 31:23 Then he took his brethren with him and pursued him for seven days' journey, and he overtook him in the mountains of Gilead.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:24: Genesis 31:24 But God had come to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said to him, "Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:25: Genesis 31:25 So Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountains, and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mountains of Gilead.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:26: Genesis 31:26 And Laban said to Jacob: "What have you done, that you have stolen away unknown to me, and carried away my daughters like captives taken with the sword?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:27: Genesis 31:27 Why did you flee away secretly, and steal away from me, and not tell me; for I might have sent you away with joy and songs, with timbrel and harp?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:28: Genesis 31:28 And you did not allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters. Now you have done foolishly in so doing.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:29: Genesis 31:29 It is in my power to do you harm, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, "˜Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:30: Genesis 31:30 And now you have surely gone because you greatly long for your father's house, but why did you steal my gods?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:31: Genesis 31:31 Then Jacob answered and said to Laban, "Because I was afraid, for I said, "˜Perhaps you would take your daughters from me by force.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:32: Genesis 31:32 With whomever you find your gods, do not let him live. In the presence of our brethren, identify what I have of yours and take it with you." For Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:33: Genesis 31:33 And Laban went into Jacob's tent, into Leah's tent, and into the two maids' tents, but he did not find them. Then he went out of Leah's tent and entered Rachel's tent.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:34: Genesis 31:34 Now Rachel had taken the household idols, put them in the camel's saddle, and sat on them. And Laban searched all about the tent but did not find them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:35: Genesis 31:35 And she said to her father, "Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise before you, for the manner of women is with me." And he searched but did not find the household idols.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:36: Genesis 31:36 Then Jacob was angry and rebuked Laban, and Jacob answered and said to Laban: "What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have so hotly pursued me?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:37: Genesis 31:37 Although you have searched all my things, what part of your household things have you found? Set it here before my brethren and your brethren, that they may judge between us both!(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:38: Genesis 31:38 These twenty years I have been with you; your ewes and your female goats have not miscarried their young, and I have not eaten the rams of your flock.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:39: Genesis 31:39 That which was torn by beasts I did not bring to you; I bore the loss of it. You required it from my hand, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:40: Genesis 31:40 There I was! In the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night, and my sleep departed from my eyes.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:41: Genesis 31:41 Thus I have been in your house twenty years; I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:42: Genesis 31:42 Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty-handed. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:43: Genesis 31:43 And Laban answered and said to Jacob, "These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and this flock is my flock; all that you see is mine. But what can I do this day to these my daughters or to their children whom they have borne?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:44: Genesis 31:44 Now therefore, come, let us make a covenant, you and I, and let it be a witness between you and me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:45: Genesis 31:45 So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:46: Genesis 31:46 Then Jacob said to his brethren, "Gather stones." And they took stones and made a heap, and they ate there on the heap.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:47: Genesis 31:47 Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:48: Genesis 31:48 And Laban said, "This heap is a witness between you and me this day." Therefore its name was called Galeed,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:49: Genesis 31:49 also Mizpah, because he said, "May the LORD watch between you and me when we are absent one from another.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:50: Genesis 31:50 If you afflict my daughters, or if you take other wives besides my daughters, although no man is with us"”see, God is witness between you and me!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:51: Genesis 31:51 Then Laban said to Jacob, "Here is this heap and here is this pillar, which I have placed between you and me.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:52: Genesis 31:52 This heap is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not pass beyond this heap to you, and you will not pass beyond this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:53: Genesis 31:53 The God of Abraham, the God of Nahor, and the God of their father judge between us." And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:54: Genesis 31:54 Then Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain, and called his brethren to eat bread. And they ate bread and stayed all night on the mountain.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 31:55: Genesis 31:55 And early in the morning Laban arose, and kissed his sons and daughters and blessed them. Then Laban departed and returned to his place.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:1: Genesis 32:1 So Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:2: Genesis 32:2 When Jacob saw them, he said, "This is God's camp." And he called the name of that place Mahanaim.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:3: Genesis 32:3 Then Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:4: Genesis 32:4 And he commanded them, saying, "Speak thus to my lord Esau, "˜Thus your servant Jacob says: "I have dwelt with Laban and stayed there until now.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:5: Genesis 32:5 I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, and male and female servants; and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight." ' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:6: Genesis 32:6 Then the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, "We came to your brother Esau, and he also is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:7: Genesis 32:7 So Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed; and he divided the people that were with him, and the flocks and herds and camels, into two companies.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:8: Genesis 32:8 And he said, "If Esau comes to the one company and attacks it, then the other company which is left will escape."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:9: Genesis 32:9 Then Jacob said, "O God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, the LORD who said to me, "˜Return to your country and to your family, and I will deal well with you':(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:10: Genesis 32:10 I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies and of all the truth which You have shown Your servant; for I crossed over this Jordan with my staff, and now I have become two companies.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:11: Genesis 32:11 Deliver me, I pray, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and attack me and the mother with the children.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:12: Genesis 32:12 For You said, "˜I will surely treat you well, and make your descendants as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:13: Genesis 32:13 So he lodged there that same night, and took what came to his hand as a present for Esau his brother:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:14: Genesis 32:14 two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:15: Genesis 32:15 thirty milk camels with their colts, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:16: Genesis 32:16 Then he delivered them to the hand of his servants, every drove by itself, and said to his servants, "Pass over before me, and put some distance between successive droves."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:17: Genesis 32:17 And he commanded the first one, saying, "When Esau my brother meets you and asks you, saying, "˜To whom do you belong, and where are you going? Whose are these in front of you?'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:18: Genesis 32:18 then you shall say, "˜They are your servant Jacob's. It is a present sent to my lord Esau; and behold, he also is behind us.' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:19: Genesis 32:19 So he commanded the second, the third, and all who followed the droves, saying, "In this manner you shall speak to Esau when you find him;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:20: Genesis 32:20 and also say, "˜Behold, your servant Jacob is behind us.' " For he said, "I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face; perhaps he will accept me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:21: Genesis 32:21 So the present went on over before him, but he himself lodged that night in the camp.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:22: Genesis 32:22 And he arose that night and took his two wives, his two female servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of Jabbok.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:23: Genesis 32:23 He took them, sent them over the brook, and sent over what he had.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:24: Genesis 32:24 Then Jacob was left alone; and a Man wrestled with him until the breaking of day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:25: Genesis 32:25 Now when He saw that He did not prevail against him, He touched the socket of his hip; and the socket of Jacob's hip was out of joint as He wrestled with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:26: Genesis 32:26 And He said, "Let Me go, for the day breaks." But he said, "I will not let You go unless You bless me!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:27: Genesis 32:27 So He said to him, "What is your name?" He said, "Jacob."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:28: Genesis 32:28 And He said, "Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have struggled with God and with men, and have prevailed."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:29: Genesis 32:29 Then Jacob asked, saying, "Tell me Your name, I pray." And He said, "Why is it that you ask about My name?" And He blessed him there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:30: Genesis 32:30 So Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: "For I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:31: Genesis 32:31 Just as he crossed over Penuel the sun rose on him, and he limped on his hip.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 32:32: Genesis 32:32 Therefore to this day the children of Israel do not eat the muscle that shrank, which is on the hip socket, because He touched the socket of Jacob's hip in the muscle that shrank.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:1: Genesis 33:1 Now Jacob lifted his eyes and looked, and there, Esau was coming, and with him were four hundred men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two maidservants.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:2: Genesis 33:2 And he put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children behind, and Rachel and Joseph last.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:3: Genesis 33:3 Then he crossed over before them and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:4: Genesis 33:4 But Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:5: Genesis 33:5 And he lifted his eyes and saw the women and children, and said, "Who are these with you?" So he said, "The children whom God has graciously given your servant."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:6: Genesis 33:6 Then the maidservants came near, they and their children, and bowed down.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:7: Genesis 33:7 And Leah also came near with her children, and they bowed down. Afterward Joseph and Rachel came near, and they bowed down.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:8: Genesis 33:8 Then Esau said, "What do you mean by all this company which I met?" And he said, "These are to find favor in the sight of my lord."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:9: Genesis 33:9 But Esau said, "I have enough, my brother; keep what you have for yourself."(NKJV)
