verses.genesis 33:10: Genesis 33:10 And Jacob said, "No, please, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present from my hand, inasmuch as I have seen your face as though I had seen the face of God, and you were pleased with me.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:11: Genesis 33:11 Please, take my blessing that is brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough." So he urged him, and he took it.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:12: Genesis 33:12 Then Esau said, "Let us take our journey; let us go, and I will go before you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:13: Genesis 33:13 But Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are weak, and the flocks and herds which are nursing are with me. And if the men should drive them hard one day, all the flock will die.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:14: Genesis 33:14 Please let my lord go on ahead before his servant. I will lead on slowly at a pace which the livestock that go before me, and the children, are able to endure, until I come to my lord in Seir."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:15: Genesis 33:15 And Esau said, "Now let me leave with you some of the people who are with me." But he said, "What need is there? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:16: Genesis 33:16 So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:17: Genesis 33:17 And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, built himself a house, and made booths for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:18: Genesis 33:18 Then Jacob came safely to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan Aram; and he pitched his tent before the city.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:19: Genesis 33:19 And he bought the parcel of land, where he had pitched his tent, from the children of Hamor, Shechem's father, for one hundred pieces of money.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 33:20: Genesis 33:20 Then he erected an altar there and called it El Elohe Israel.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:1: Genesis 34:1 Now Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:2: Genesis 34:2 And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her and lay with her, and violated her.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:3: Genesis 34:3 His soul was strongly attracted to Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young woman and spoke kindly to the young woman.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:4: Genesis 34:4 So Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, "Get me this young woman as a wife."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:5: Genesis 34:5 And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter. Now his sons were with his livestock in the field; so Jacob held his peace until they came.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:6: Genesis 34:6 Then Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:7: Genesis 34:7 And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it; and the men were grieved and very angry, because he had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob's daughter, a thing which ought not to be done.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:8: Genesis 34:8 But Hamor spoke with them, saying, "The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:9: Genesis 34:9 And make marriages with us; give your daughters to us, and take our daughters to yourselves.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:10: Genesis 34:10 So you shall dwell with us, and the land shall be before you. Dwell and trade in it, and acquire possessions for yourselves in it."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:11: Genesis 34:11 Then Shechem said to her father and her brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you say to me I will give.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:12: Genesis 34:12 Ask me ever so much dowry and gift, and I will give according to what you say to me; but give me the young woman as a wife."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:13: Genesis 34:13 But the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father, and spoke deceitfully, because he had defiled Dinah their sister.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:14: Genesis 34:14 And they said to them, "We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised, for that would be a reproach to us.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:15: Genesis 34:15 But on this condition we will consent to you: If you will become as we are, if every male of you is circumcised,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:16: Genesis 34:16 then we will give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to us; and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:17: Genesis 34:17 But if you will not heed us and be circumcised, then we will take our daughter and be gone."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:18: Genesis 34:18 And their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor's son.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:19: Genesis 34:19 So the young man did not delay to do the thing, because he delighted in Jacob's daughter. He was more honorable than all the household of his father.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:20: Genesis 34:20 And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke with the men of their city, saying:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:21: Genesis 34:21 "These men are at peace with us. Therefore let them dwell in the land and trade in it. For indeed the land is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters to us as wives, and let us give them our daughters.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:22: Genesis 34:22 Only on this condition will the men consent to dwell with us, to be one people: if every male among us is circumcised as they are circumcised.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:23: Genesis 34:23 Will not their livestock, their property, and every animal of theirs be ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell with us."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:24: Genesis 34:24 And all who went out of the gate of his city heeded Hamor and Shechem his son; every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:25: Genesis 34:25 Now it came to pass on the third day, when they were in pain, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, each took his sword and came boldly upon the city and killed all the males.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:26: Genesis 34:26 And they killed Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah from Shechem's house, and went out.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:27: Genesis 34:27 The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because their sister had been defiled.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:28: Genesis 34:28 They took their sheep, their oxen, and their donkeys, what was in the city and what was in the field,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:29: Genesis 34:29 and all their wealth. All their little ones and their wives they took captive; and they plundered even all that was in the houses.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:30: Genesis 34:30 Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have troubled me by making me obnoxious among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites; and since I am few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and kill me. I shall be destroyed, my household and I."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 34:31: Genesis 34:31 But they said, "Should he treat our sister like a harlot?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:1: Genesis 35:1 Then God said to Jacob, "Arise, go up to Bethel and dwell there; and make an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:2: Genesis 35:2 And Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, "Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:3: Genesis 35:3 Then let us arise and go up to Bethel; and I will make an altar there to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and has been with me in the way which I have gone."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:4: Genesis 35:4 So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the terebinth tree which was by Shechem.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:5: Genesis 35:5 And they journeyed, and the terror of God was upon the cities that were all around them, and they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:6: Genesis 35:6 So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:7: Genesis 35:7 And he built an altar there and called the place El Bethel, because there God appeared to him when he fled from the face of his brother.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:8: Genesis 35:8 Now Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the terebinth tree. So the name of it was called Allon Bachuth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:9: Genesis 35:9 Then God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Padan Aram, and blessed him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:10: Genesis 35:10 And God said to him, "Your name is Jacob; your name shall not be called Jacob anymore, but Israel shall be your name." So He called his name Israel.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:11: Genesis 35:11 Also God said to him: "I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall proceed from you, and kings shall come from your body.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:12: Genesis 35:12 The land which I gave Abraham and Isaac I give to you; and to your descendants after you I give this land."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:13: Genesis 35:13 Then God went up from him in the place where He talked with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:14: Genesis 35:14 So Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He talked with him, a pillar of stone; and he poured a drink offering on it, and he poured oil on it.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:15: Genesis 35:15 And Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him, Bethel.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:16: Genesis 35:16 Then they journeyed from Bethel. And when there was but a little distance to go to Ephrath, Rachel labored in childbirth, and she had hard labor.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:17: Genesis 35:17 Now it came to pass, when she was in hard labor, that the midwife said to her, "Do not fear; you will have this son also."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:18: Genesis 35:18 And so it was, as her soul was departing (for she died), that she called his name Ben-Oni; but his father called him Benjamin.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:19: Genesis 35:19 So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:20: Genesis 35:20 And Jacob set a pillar on her grave, which is the pillar of Rachel's grave to this day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:21: Genesis 35:21 Then Israel journeyed and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:22: Genesis 35:22 And it happened, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine; and Israel heard about it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:23: Genesis 35:23 the sons of Leah were Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:24: Genesis 35:24 the sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:25: Genesis 35:25 the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant, were Dan and Naphtali;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:26: Genesis 35:26 and the sons of Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, were Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Padan Aram.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:27: Genesis 35:27 Then Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, or Kirjath Arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had dwelt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:28: Genesis 35:28 Now the days of Isaac were one hundred and eighty years.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 35:29: Genesis 35:29 So Isaac breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people, being old and full of days. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:1: Genesis 36:1 Now this is the genealogy of Esau, who is Edom.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:2: Genesis 36:2 Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite; Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:3: Genesis 36:3 and Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, sister of Nebajoth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:4: Genesis 36:4 Now Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:5: Genesis 36:5 And Aholibamah bore Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah. These were the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:6: Genesis 36:6 Then Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the persons of his household, his cattle and all his animals, and all his goods which he had gained in the land of Canaan, and went to a country away from the presence of his brother Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:7: Genesis 36:7 For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together, and the land where they were strangers could not support them because of their livestock.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:8: Genesis 36:8 So Esau dwelt in Mount Seir. Esau is Edom.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:9: Genesis 36:9 And this is the genealogy of Esau the father of the Edomites in Mount Seir.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:10: Genesis 36:10 These were the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, and Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:11: Genesis 36:11 And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:12: Genesis 36:12 Now Timna was the concubine of Eliphaz, Esau's son, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These were the sons of Adah, Esau's wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:13: Genesis 36:13 These were the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:14: Genesis 36:14 These were the sons of Aholibamah, Esau's wife, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon. And she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:15: Genesis 36:15 These were the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn son of Esau, were Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Zepho, Chief Kenaz,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:16: Genesis 36:16 Chief Korah, Chief Gatam, and Chief Amalek. These were the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. They were the sons of Adah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:17: Genesis 36:17 These were the sons of Reuel, Esau's son: Chief Nahath, Chief Zerah, Chief Shammah, and Chief Mizzah. These were the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:18: Genesis 36:18 And these were the sons of Aholibamah, Esau's wife: Chief Jeush, Chief Jaalam, and Chief Korah. These were the chiefs who descended from Aholibamah, Esau's wife, the daughter of Anah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:19: Genesis 36:19 These were the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these were their chiefs.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:20: Genesis 36:20 These were the sons of Seir the Horite who inhabited the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:21: Genesis 36:21 Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These were the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir, in the land of Edom.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:22: Genesis 36:22 And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Lotan's sister was Timna.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:23: Genesis 36:23 These were the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:24: Genesis 36:24 These were the sons of Zibeon: both Ajah and Anah. This was the Anah who found the water in the wilderness as he pastured the donkeys of his father Zibeon.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:25: Genesis 36:25 These were the children of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:26: Genesis 36:26 These were the sons of Dishon:Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:27: Genesis 36:27 These were the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:28: Genesis 36:28 These were the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:29: Genesis 36:29 These were the chiefs of the Horites: Chief Lotan, Chief Shobal, Chief Zibeon, Chief Anah,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:30: Genesis 36:30 Chief Dishon, Chief Ezer, and Chief Dishan. These were the chiefs of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:31: Genesis 36:31 Now these were the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:32: Genesis 36:32 Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:33: Genesis 36:33 And when Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:34: Genesis 36:34 When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:35: Genesis 36:35 And when Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who attacked Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:36: Genesis 36:36 When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:37: Genesis 36:37 And when Samlah died, Saul of Rehoboth-by-the-River reigned in his place.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:38: Genesis 36:38 When Saul died, Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:39: Genesis 36:39 And when Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor died, Hadar reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pau. His wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:40: Genesis 36:40 And these were the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their families and their places, by their names: Chief Timnah, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:41: Genesis 36:41 Chief Aholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:42: Genesis 36:42 Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 36:43: Genesis 36:43 Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their dwelling places in the land of their possession. Esau was the father of the Edomites.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:1: Genesis 37:1 Now Jacob dwelt in the land where his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:2: Genesis 37:2 This is the history of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. And the lad was with the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives; and Joseph brought a bad report of them to his father.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:3: Genesis 37:3 Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age. Also he made him a tunic of many colors.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:4: Genesis 37:4 But when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him and could not speak peaceably to him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:5: Genesis 37:5 Now Joseph had a dream, and he told it to his brothers; and they hated him even more.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:6: Genesis 37:6 So he said to them, "Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:7: Genesis 37:7 There we were, binding sheaves in the field. Then behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and indeed your sheaves stood all around and bowed down to my sheaf."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:8: Genesis 37:8 And his brothers said to him, "Shall you indeed reign over us? Or shall you indeed have dominion over us?" So they hated him even more for his dreams and for his words.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:9: Genesis 37:9 Then he dreamed still another dream and told it to his brothers, and said, "Look, I have dreamed another dream. And this time, the sun, the moon, and the eleven stars bowed down to me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:10: Genesis 37:10 So he told it to his father and his brothers; and his father rebuked him and said to him, "What is this dream that you have dreamed? Shall your mother and I and your brothers indeed come to bow down to the earth before you?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:11: Genesis 37:11 And his brothers envied him, but his father kept the matter in mind.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:12: Genesis 37:12 Then his brothers went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:13: Genesis 37:13 And Israel said to Joseph, "Are not your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, I will send you to them." So he said to him, "Here I am."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:14: Genesis 37:14 Then he said to him, "Please go and see if it is well with your brothers and well with the flocks, and bring back word to me." So he sent him out of the Valley of Hebron, and he went to Shechem.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:15: Genesis 37:15 Now a certain man found him, and there he was, wandering in the field. And the man asked him, saying, "What are you seeking?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:16: Genesis 37:16 So he said, "I am seeking my brothers. Please tell me where they are feeding their flocks."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:17: Genesis 37:17 And the man said, "They have departed from here, for I heard them say, "˜Let us go to Dothan.' " So Joseph went after his brothers and found them in Dothan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:18: Genesis 37:18 Now when they saw him afar off, even before he came near them, they conspired against him to kill him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:19: Genesis 37:19 Then they said to one another, "Look, this dreamer is coming!(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:20: Genesis 37:20 Come therefore, let us now kill him and cast him into some pit; and we shall say, "˜Some wild beast has devoured him.' We shall see what will become of his dreams!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:21: Genesis 37:21 But Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands, and said, "Let us not kill him."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:22: Genesis 37:22 And Reuben said to them, "Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit which is in the wilderness, and do not lay a hand on him""”that he might deliver him out of their hands, and bring him back to his father.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:23: Genesis 37:23 So it came to pass, when Joseph had come to his brothers, that they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:24: Genesis 37:24 Then they took him and cast him into a pit. And the pit was empty; there was no water in it.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:25: Genesis 37:25 And they sat down to eat a meal. Then they lifted their eyes and looked, and there was a company of Ishmaelites, coming from Gilead with their camels, bearing spices, balm, and myrrh, on their way to carry them down to Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:26: Genesis 37:26 So Judah said to his brothers, "What profit is there if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:27: Genesis 37:27 Come and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him, for he is our brother and our flesh." And his brothers listened.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:28: Genesis 37:28 Then Midianite traders passed by; so the brothers pulled Joseph up and lifted him out of the pit, and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver. And they took Joseph to Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:29: Genesis 37:29 Then Reuben returned to the pit, and indeed Joseph was not in the pit; and he tore his clothes.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:30: Genesis 37:30 And he returned to his brothers and said, "The lad is no more; and I, where shall I go?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:31: Genesis 37:31 So they took Joseph's tunic, killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the tunic in the blood.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:32: Genesis 37:32 Then they sent the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father and said, "We have found this. Do you know whether it is your son's tunic or not?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:33: Genesis 37:33 And he recognized it and said, "It is my son's tunic. A wild beast has devoured him. Without doubt Joseph is torn to pieces."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:34: Genesis 37:34 Then Jacob tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:35: Genesis 37:35 And all his sons and all his daughters arose to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted, and he said, "For I shall go down into the grave to my son in mourning." Thus his father wept for him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 37:36: Genesis 37:36 Now the Midianites had sold him in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:1: Genesis 38:1 It came to pass at that time that Judah departed from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite whose name was Hirah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:2: Genesis 38:2 And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua, and he married her and went in to her.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:3: Genesis 38:3 So she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Er.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:4: Genesis 38:4 She conceived again and bore a son, and she called his name Onan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:5: Genesis 38:5 And she conceived yet again and bore a son, and called his name Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:6: Genesis 38:6 Then Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:7: Genesis 38:7 But Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the LORD, and the LORD killed him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:8: Genesis 38:8 And Judah said to Onan, "Go in to your brother's wife and marry her, and raise up an heir to your brother."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:9: Genesis 38:9 But Onan knew that the heir would not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in to his brother's wife, that he emitted on the ground, lest he should give an heir to his brother.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:10: Genesis 38:10 And the thing which he did displeased the LORD; therefore He killed him also.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:11: Genesis 38:11 Then Judah said to Tamar his daughter-in-law, "Remain a widow in your father's house till my son Shelah is grown." For he said, "Lest he also die like his brothers." And Tamar went and dwelt in her father's house.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:12: Genesis 38:12 Now in the process of time the daughter of Shua, Judah's wife, died; and Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:13: Genesis 38:13 And it was told Tamar, saying, "Look, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:14: Genesis 38:14 So she took off her widow's garments, covered herself with a veil and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place which was on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given to him as a wife.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:15: Genesis 38:15 When Judah saw her, he thought she was a harlot, because she had covered her face.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:16: Genesis 38:16 Then he turned to her by the way, and said, "Please let me come in to you"; for he did not know that she was his daughter-in-law. So she said, "What will you give me, that you may come in to me?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:17: Genesis 38:17 And he said, "I will send a young goat from the flock." So she said, "Will you give me a pledge till you send it?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:18: Genesis 38:18 Then he said, "What pledge shall I give you?" So she said, "Your signet and cord, and your staff that is in your hand." Then he gave them to her, and went in to her, and she conceived by him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:19: Genesis 38:19 So she arose and went away, and laid aside her veil and put on the garments of her widowhood.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:20: Genesis 38:20 And Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman's hand, but he did not find her.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:21: Genesis 38:21 Then he asked the men of that place, saying, "Where is the harlot who was openly by the roadside?" And they said, "There was no harlot in this place."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:22: Genesis 38:22 So he returned to Judah and said, "I cannot find her. Also, the men of the place said there was no harlot in this place."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:23: Genesis 38:23 Then Judah said, "Let her take them for herself, lest we be shamed; for I sent this young goat and you have not found her."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:24: Genesis 38:24 And it came to pass, about three months after, that Judah was told, saying, "Tamar your daughter-in-law has played the harlot; furthermore she is with child by harlotry." So Judah said, "Bring her out and let her be burned!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:25: Genesis 38:25 When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, "By the man to whom these belong, I am with child." And she said, "Please determine whose these are"”the signet and cord, and staff."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:26: Genesis 38:26 So Judah acknowledged them and said, "She has been more righteous than I, because I did not give her to Shelah my son." And he never knew her again.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:27: Genesis 38:27 Now it came to pass, at the time for giving birth, that behold, twins were in her womb.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:28: Genesis 38:28 And so it was, when she was giving birth, that the one put out his hand; and the midwife took a scarlet thread and bound it on his hand, saying, "This one came out first."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:29: Genesis 38:29 Then it happened, as he drew back his hand, that his brother came out unexpectedly; and she said, "How did you break through? This breach be upon you!" Therefore his name was called Perez.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 38:30: Genesis 38:30 Afterward his brother came out who had the scarlet thread on his hand. And his name was called Zerah.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:1: Genesis 39:1 Now Joseph had been taken down to Egypt. And Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him down there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:2: Genesis 39:2 The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a successful man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:3: Genesis 39:3 And his master saw that the LORD was with him and that the LORD made all he did to prosper in his hand.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:4: Genesis 39:4 So Joseph found favor in his sight, and served him. Then he made him overseer of his house, and all that he had he put under his authority.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:5: Genesis 39:5 So it was, from the time that he had made him overseer of his house and all that he had, that the LORD blessed the Egyptian's house for Joseph's sake; and the blessing of the LORD was on all that he had in the house and in the field.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:6: Genesis 39:6 Thus he left all that he had in Joseph's hand, and he did not know what he had except for the bread which he ate. Now Joseph was handsome in form and appearance.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:7: Genesis 39:7 And it came to pass after these things that his master's wife cast longing eyes on Joseph, and she said, "Lie with me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:8: Genesis 39:8 But he refused and said to his master's wife, "Look, my master does not know what is with me in the house, and he has committed all that he has to my hand.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:9: Genesis 39:9 There is no one greater in this house than I, nor has he kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:10: Genesis 39:10 So it was, as she spoke to Joseph day by day, that he did not heed her, to lie with her or to be with her.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:11: Genesis 39:11 But it happened about this time, when Joseph went into the house to do his work, and none of the men of the house was inside,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:12: Genesis 39:12 that she caught him by his garment, saying, "Lie with me." But he left his garment in her hand, and fled and ran outside.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:13: Genesis 39:13 And so it was, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and fled outside,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:14: Genesis 39:14 that she called to the men of her house and spoke to them, saying, "See, he has brought in to us a Hebrew to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried out with a loud voice.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:15: Genesis 39:15 And it happened, when he heard that I lifted my voice and cried out, that he left his garment with me, and fled and went outside."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:16: Genesis 39:16 So she kept his garment with her until his master came home.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:17: Genesis 39:17 Then she spoke to him with words like these, saying, "The Hebrew servant whom you brought to us came in to me to mock me;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:18: Genesis 39:18 so it happened, as I lifted my voice and cried out, that he left his garment with me and fled outside."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:19: Genesis 39:19 So it was, when his master heard the words which his wife spoke to him, saying, "Your servant did to me after this manner," that his anger was aroused.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:20: Genesis 39:20 Then Joseph's master took him and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were confined. And he was there in the prison.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:21: Genesis 39:21 But the LORD was with Joseph and showed him mercy, and He gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:22: Genesis 39:22 And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph's hand all the prisoners who were in the prison; whatever they did there, it was his doing.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 39:23: Genesis 39:23 The keeper of the prison did not look into anything that was under Joseph's authority, because the LORD was with him; and whatever he did, the LORD made it prosper.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:1: Genesis 40:1 It came to pass after these things that the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their lord, the king of Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:2: Genesis 40:2 And Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief butler and the chief baker.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:3: Genesis 40:3 So he put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the prison, the place where Joseph was confined.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:4: Genesis 40:4 And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them; so they were in custody for a while.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:5: Genesis 40:5 Then the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were confined in the prison, had a dream, both of them, each man's dream in one night and each man's dream with its own interpretation.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:6: Genesis 40:6 And Joseph came in to them in the morning and looked at them, and saw that they were sad.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:7: Genesis 40:7 So he asked Pharaoh's officers who were with him in the custody of his lord's house, saying, "Why do you look so sad today?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:8: Genesis 40:8 And they said to him, "We each have had a dream, and there is no interpreter of it." So Joseph said to them, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Tell them to me, please."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:9: Genesis 40:9 Then the chief butler told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, "Behold, in my dream a vine was before me,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:10: Genesis 40:10 and in the vine were three branches; it was as though it budded, its blossoms shot forth, and its clusters brought forth ripe grapes.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:11: Genesis 40:11 Then Pharaoh's cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and placed the cup in Pharaoh's hand."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:12: Genesis 40:12 And Joseph said to him, "This is the interpretation of it: The three branches are three days.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:13: Genesis 40:13 Now within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore you to your place, and you will put Pharaoh's cup in his hand according to the former manner, when you were his butler.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:14: Genesis 40:14 But remember me when it is well with you, and please show kindness to me; make mention of me to Pharaoh, and get me out of this house.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:15: Genesis 40:15 For indeed I was stolen away from the land of the Hebrews; and also I have done nothing here that they should put me into the dungeon."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:16: Genesis 40:16 When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, "I also was in my dream, and there were three white baskets on my head.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:17: Genesis 40:17 In the uppermost basket were all kinds of baked goods for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:18: Genesis 40:18 So Joseph answered and said, "This is the interpretation of it: The three baskets are three days.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:19: Genesis 40:19 Within three days Pharaoh will lift off your head from you and hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:20: Genesis 40:20 Now it came to pass on the third day, which was Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast for all his servants; and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:21: Genesis 40:21 Then he restored the chief butler to his butlership again, and he placed the cup in Pharaoh's hand.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:22: Genesis 40:22 But he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 40:23: Genesis 40:23 Yet the chief butler did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:1: Genesis 41:1 Then it came to pass, at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh had a dream; and behold, he stood by the river.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:2: Genesis 41:2 Suddenly there came up out of the river seven cows, fine looking and fat; and they fed in the meadow.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:3: Genesis 41:3 Then behold, seven other cows came up after them out of the river, ugly and gaunt, and stood by the other cows on the bank of the river.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:4: Genesis 41:4 And the ugly and gaunt cows ate up the seven fine looking and fat cows. So Pharaoh awoke.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:5: Genesis 41:5 He slept and dreamed a second time; and suddenly seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, plump and good.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:6: Genesis 41:6 Then behold, seven thin heads, blighted by the east wind, sprang up after them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:7: Genesis 41:7 And the seven thin heads devoured the seven plump and full heads. So Pharaoh awoke, and indeed, it was a dream.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:8: Genesis 41:8 Now it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt and all its wise men. And Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them for Pharaoh.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:9: Genesis 41:9 Then the chief butler spoke to Pharaoh, saying: "I remember my faults this day.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:10: Genesis 41:10 When Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, both me and the chief baker,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:11: Genesis 41:11 we each had a dream in one night, he and I. Each of us dreamed according to the interpretation of his own dream.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:12: Genesis 41:12 Now there was a young Hebrew man with us there, a servant of the captain of the guard. And we told him, and he interpreted our dreams for us; to each man he interpreted according to his own dream.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:13: Genesis 41:13 And it came to pass, just as he interpreted for us, so it happened. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:14: Genesis 41:14 Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him quickly out of the dungeon; and he shaved, changed his clothing, and came to Pharaoh.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:15: Genesis 41:15 And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I have had a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that you can understand a dream, to interpret it."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:16: Genesis 41:16 So Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, "It is not in me; God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:17: Genesis 41:17 Then Pharaoh said to Joseph: "Behold, in my dream I stood on the bank of the river.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:18: Genesis 41:18 Suddenly seven cows came up out of the river, fine looking and fat; and they fed in the meadow.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:19: Genesis 41:19 Then behold, seven other cows came up after them, poor and very ugly and gaunt, such ugliness as I have never seen in all the land of Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:20: Genesis 41:20 And the gaunt and ugly cows ate up the first seven, the fat cows.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:21: Genesis 41:21 When they had eaten them up, no one would have known that they had eaten them, for they were just as ugly as at the beginning. So I awoke.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:22: Genesis 41:22 Also I saw in my dream, and suddenly seven heads came up on one stalk, full and good.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:23: Genesis 41:23 Then behold, seven heads, withered, thin, and blighted by the east wind, sprang up after them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:24: Genesis 41:24 And the thin heads devoured the seven good heads. So I told this to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:25: Genesis 41:25 Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, "The dreams of Pharaoh are one; God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:26: Genesis 41:26 The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads are seven years; the dreams are one.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:27: Genesis 41:27 And the seven thin and ugly cows which came up after them are seven years, and the seven empty heads blighted by the east wind are seven years of famine.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:28: Genesis 41:28 This is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:29: Genesis 41:29 Indeed seven years of great plenty will come throughout all the land of Egypt;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:30: Genesis 41:30 but after them seven years of famine will arise, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine will deplete the land.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:31: Genesis 41:31 So the plenty will not be known in the land because of the famine following, for it will be very severe.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:32: Genesis 41:32 And the dream was repeated to Pharaoh twice because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:33: Genesis 41:33 "Now therefore, let Pharaoh select a discerning and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:34: Genesis 41:34 Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, to collect one-fifth of the produce of the land of Egypt in the seven plentiful years.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:35: Genesis 41:35 And let them gather all the food of those good years that are coming, and store up grain under the authority of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:36: Genesis 41:36 Then that food shall be as a reserve for the land for the seven years of famine which shall be in the land of Egypt, that the land may not perish during the famine."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:37: Genesis 41:37 So the advice was good in the eyes of Pharaoh and in the eyes of all his servants.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:38: Genesis 41:38 And Pharaoh said to his servants, "Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:39: Genesis 41:39 Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Inasmuch as God has shown you all this, there is no one as discerning and wise as you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:40: Genesis 41:40 You shall be over my house, and all my people shall be ruled according to your word; only in regard to the throne will I be greater than you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:41: Genesis 41:41 And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:42: Genesis 41:42 Then Pharaoh took his signet ring off his hand and put it on Joseph's hand; and he clothed him in garments of fine linen and put a gold chain around his neck.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:43: Genesis 41:43 And he had him ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried out before him, "Bow the knee!" So he set him over all the land of Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:44: Genesis 41:44 Pharaoh also said to Joseph, "I am Pharaoh, and without your consent no man may lift his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:45: Genesis 41:45 And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnath-Paaneah. And he gave him as a wife Asenath, the daughter of Poti-Pherah priest of On. So Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:46: Genesis 41:46 Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:47: Genesis 41:47 Now in the seven plentiful years the ground brought forth abundantly.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:48: Genesis 41:48 So he gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities; he laid up in every city the food of the fields which surrounded them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:49: Genesis 41:49 Joseph gathered very much grain, as the sand of the sea, until he stopped counting, for it was immeasurable.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:50: Genesis 41:50 And to Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-Pherah priest of On, bore to him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:51: Genesis 41:51 Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: "For God has made me forget all my toil and all my father's house."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:52: Genesis 41:52 And the name of the second he called Ephraim: "For God has caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:53: Genesis 41:53 Then the seven years of plenty which were in the land of Egypt ended,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:54: Genesis 41:54 and the seven years of famine began to come, as Joseph had said. The famine was in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:55: Genesis 41:55 So when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread. Then Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph; whatever he says to you, do."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:56: Genesis 41:56 The famine was over all the face of the earth, and Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold to the Egyptians. And the famine became severe in the land of Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 41:57: Genesis 41:57 So all countries came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all lands.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:1: Genesis 42:1 When Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, Jacob said to his sons, "Why do you look at one another?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:2: Genesis 42:2 And he said, "Indeed I have heard that there is grain in Egypt; go down to that place and buy for us there, that we may live and not die."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:3: Genesis 42:3 So Joseph's ten brothers went down to buy grain in Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:4: Genesis 42:4 But Jacob did not send Joseph's brother Benjamin with his brothers, for he said, "Lest some calamity befall him."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:5: Genesis 42:5 And the sons of Israel went to buy grain among those who journeyed, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:6: Genesis 42:6 Now Joseph was governor over the land; and it was he who sold to all the people of the land. And Joseph's brothers came and bowed down before him with their faces to the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:7: Genesis 42:7 Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them, but he acted as a stranger to them and spoke roughly to them. Then he said to them, "Where do you come from?" And they said, "From the land of Canaan to buy food."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:8: Genesis 42:8 So Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:9: Genesis 42:9 Then Joseph remembered the dreams which he had dreamed about them, and said to them, "You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:10: Genesis 42:10 And they said to him, "No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:11: Genesis 42:11 We are all one man's sons; we are honest men; your servants are not spies."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:12: Genesis 42:12 But he said to them, "No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:13: Genesis 42:13 And they said, "Your servants are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and in fact, the youngest is with our father today, and one is no more."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:14: Genesis 42:14 But Joseph said to them, "It is as I spoke to you, saying, "˜You are spies!'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:15: Genesis 42:15 In this manner you shall be tested: By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:16: Genesis 42:16 Send one of you, and let him bring your brother; and you shall be kept in prison, that your words may be tested to see whether there is any truth in you; or else, by the life of Pharaoh, surely you are spies!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:17: Genesis 42:17 So he put them all together in prison three days.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:18: Genesis 42:18 Then Joseph said to them the third day, "Do this and live, for I fear God:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:19: Genesis 42:19 If you are honest men, let one of your brothers be confined to your prison house; but you, go and carry grain for the famine of your houses.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:20: Genesis 42:20 And bring your young est brother to me; so your words will be verified, and you shall not die." And they did so.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:21: Genesis 42:21 Then they said to one another, "We are truly guilty concerning our brother, for we saw the anguish of his soul when he pleaded with us, and we would not hear; therefore this distress has come upon us."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:22: Genesis 42:22 And Reuben answered them, saying, "Did I not speak to you, saying, "˜Do not sin against the boy'; and you would not listen? Therefore behold, his blood is now required of us."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:23: Genesis 42:23 But they did not know that Joseph understood them, for he spoke to them through an interpreter.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:24: Genesis 42:24 And he turned himself away from them and wept. Then he returned to them again, and talked with them. And he took Simeon from them and bound him before their eyes.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:25: Genesis 42:25 Then Joseph gave a command to fill their sacks with grain, to restore every man's money to his sack, and to give them provisions for the journey. Thus he did for them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:26: Genesis 42:26 So they loaded their donkeys with the grain and departed from there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:27: Genesis 42:27 But as one of them opened his sack to give his donkey feed at the encampment, he saw his money; and there it was, in the mouth of his sack.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:28: Genesis 42:28 So he said to his brothers, "My money has been restored, and there it is, in my sack!" Then their hearts failed them and they were afraid, saying to one another, "What is this that God has done to us?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:29: Genesis 42:29 Then they went to Jacob their father in the land of Canaan and told him all that had happened to them, saying:(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:30: Genesis 42:30 "The man who is lord of the land spoke roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:31: Genesis 42:31 But we said to him, "˜We are honest men; we are not spies.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:32: Genesis 42:32 We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is with our father this day in the land of Canaan.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:33: Genesis 42:33 Then the man, the lord of the country, said to us, "˜By this I will know that you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers here with me, take food for the famine of your households, and be gone.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:34: Genesis 42:34 And bring your youngest brother to me; so I shall know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. I will grant your brother to you, and you may trade in the land.' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:35: Genesis 42:35 Then it happened as they emptied their sacks, that surprisingly each man's bundle of money was in his sack; and when they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:36: Genesis 42:36 And Jacob their father said to them, "You have bereaved me: Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin. All these things are against me."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:37: Genesis 42:37 Then Reuben spoke to his father, saying, "Kill my two sons if I do not bring him back to you; put him in my hands, and I will bring him back to you."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 42:38: Genesis 42:38 But he said, "My son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead, and he is left alone. If any calamity should befall him along the way in which you go, then you would bring down my gray hair with sorrow to the grave."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:1: Genesis 43:1 Now the famine was severe in the land.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:2: Genesis 43:2 And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the grain which they had brought from Egypt, that their father said to them, "Go back, buy us a little food."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:3: Genesis 43:3 But Judah spoke to him, saying, "The man solemnly warned us, saying, "˜You shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:4: Genesis 43:4 If you send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:5: Genesis 43:5 But if you will not send him, we will not go down; for the man said to us, "˜You shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:6: Genesis 43:6 And Israel said, "Why did you deal so wrongfully with me as to tell the man whether you had still another brother?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:7: Genesis 43:7 But they said, "The man asked us pointedly about ourselves and our family, saying, "˜Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?' And we told him according to these words. Could we possibly have known that he would say, "˜Bring your brother down'?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:8: Genesis 43:8 Then Judah said to Israel his father, "Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go, that we may live and not die, both we and you and also our little ones.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:9: Genesis 43:9 I myself will be surety for him; from my hand you shall require him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:10: Genesis 43:10 For if we had not lingered, surely by now we would have returned this second time."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:11: Genesis 43:11 And their father Israel said to them, "If it must be so, then do this: Take some of the best fruits of the land in your vessels and carry down a present for the man"”a little balm and a little honey, spices and myrrh, pistachio nuts and almonds.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:12: Genesis 43:12 Take double money in your hand, and take back in your hand the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks; perhaps it was an oversight.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:13: Genesis 43:13 Take your brother also, and arise, go back to the man.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:14: Genesis 43:14 And may God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved, I am bereaved!"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:15: Genesis 43:15 So the men took that present and Benjamin, and they took double money in their hand, and arose and went down to Egypt; and they stood before Joseph.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:16: Genesis 43:16 When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, "Take these men to my home, and slaughter an animal and make ready; for these men will dine with me at noon."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:17: Genesis 43:17 Then the man did as Joseph ordered, and the man brought the men into Joseph's house.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:18: Genesis 43:18 Now the men were afraid because they were brought into Joseph's house; and they said, "It is because of the money, which was returned in our sacks the first time, that we are brought in, so that he may make a case against us and seize us, to take us as slaves with our donkeys."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:19: Genesis 43:19 When they drew near to the steward of Joseph's house, they talked with him at the door of the house,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:20: Genesis 43:20 and said, "O sir, we indeed came down the first time to buy food;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:21: Genesis 43:21 but it happened, when we came to the encampment, that we opened our sacks, and there, each man's money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight; so we have brought it back in our hand.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:22: Genesis 43:22 And we have brought down other money in our hands to buy food. We do not know who put our money in our sacks."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:23: Genesis 43:23 But he said, "Peace be with you, do not be afraid. Your God and the God of your father has given you treasure in your sacks; I had your money." Then he brought Simeon out to them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:24: Genesis 43:24 So the man brought the men into Joseph's house and gave them water, and they washed their feet; and he gave their donkeys feed.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:25: Genesis 43:25 Then they made the present ready for Joseph's coming at noon, for they heard that they would eat bread there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:26: Genesis 43:26 And when Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed down before him to the earth.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:27: Genesis 43:27 Then he asked them about their well-being, and said, "Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he still alive?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:28: Genesis 43:28 And they answered, "Your servant our father is in good health; he is still alive." And they bowed their heads down and prostrated themselves.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:29: Genesis 43:29 Then he lifted his eyes and saw his brother Benjamin, his mother's son, and said, "Is this your younger brother of whom you spoke to me?" And he said, "God be gracious to you, my son."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:30: Genesis 43:30 Now his heart yearned for his brother; so Joseph made haste and sought somewhere to weep. And he went into his chamber and wept there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:31: Genesis 43:31 Then he washed his face and came out; and he restrained himself, and said, "Serve the bread."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:32: Genesis 43:32 So they set him a place by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves; because the Egyptians could not eat food with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:33: Genesis 43:33 And they sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright and the youngest according to his youth; and the men looked in astonishment at one another.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 43:34: Genesis 43:34 Then he took servings to them from before him, but Benjamin's serving was five times as much as any of theirs. So they drank and were merry with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:1: Genesis 44:1 And he commanded the steward of his house, saying, "Fill the men's sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man's money in the mouth of his sack.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:2: Genesis 44:2 Also put my cup, the silver cup, in the mouth of the sack of the youngest, and his grain money." So he did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:3: Genesis 44:3 As soon as the morning dawned, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:4: Genesis 44:4 When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, "Get up, follow the men; and when you overtake them, say to them, "˜Why have you repaid evil for good?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:5: Genesis 44:5 Is not this the one from which my lord drinks, and with which he indeed practices divination? You have done evil in so doing.' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:6: Genesis 44:6 So he overtook them, and he spoke to them these same words.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:7: Genesis 44:7 And they said to him, "Why does my lord say these words? Far be it from us that your servants should do such a thing.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:8: Genesis 44:8 Look, we brought back to you from the land of Canaan the money which we found in the mouth of our sacks. How then could we steal silver or gold from your lord's house?(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:9: Genesis 44:9 With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord's slaves."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:10: Genesis 44:10 And he said, "Now also let it be according to your words; he with whom it is found shall be my slave, and you shall be blameless."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:11: Genesis 44:11 Then each man speedily let down his sack to the ground, and each opened his sack.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:12: Genesis 44:12 So he searched. He began with the oldest and left off with the youngest; and the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:13: Genesis 44:13 Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey and returned to the city.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:14: Genesis 44:14 So Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house, and he was still there; and they fell before him on the ground.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:15: Genesis 44:15 And Joseph said to them, "What deed is this you have done? Did you not know that such a man as I can certainly practice divination?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:16: Genesis 44:16 Then Judah said, "What shall we say to my lord? What shall we speak? Or how shall we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants; here we are, my lord's slaves, both we and he also with whom the cup was found."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:17: Genesis 44:17 But he said, "Far be it from me that I should do so; the man in whose hand the cup was found, he shall be my slave. And as for you, go up in peace to your father."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:18: Genesis 44:18 Then Judah came near to him and said: "O my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord's hearing, and do not let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even like Pharaoh.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:19: Genesis 44:19 My lord asked his servants, saying, "˜Have you a father or a brother?'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:20: Genesis 44:20 And we said to my lord, "˜We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, who is young; his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother's children, and his father loves him.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:21: Genesis 44:21 Then you said to your servants, "˜Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:22: Genesis 44:22 And we said to my lord, "˜The lad cannot leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:23: Genesis 44:23 But you said to your servants, "˜Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you shall see my face no more.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:24: Genesis 44:24 "So it was, when we went up to your servant my father, that we told him the words of my lord.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:25: Genesis 44:25 And our father said, "˜Go back and buy us a little food.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:26: Genesis 44:26 But we said, "˜We cannot go down; if our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down; for we may not see the man's face unless our youngest brother is with us.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:27: Genesis 44:27 Then your servant my father said to us, "˜You know that my wife bore me two sons;(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:28: Genesis 44:28 and the one went out from me, and I said, "Surely he is torn to pieces"; and I have not seen him since.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:29: Genesis 44:29 But if you take this one also from me, and calamity befalls him, you shall bring down my gray hair with sorrow to the grave.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:30: Genesis 44:30 "Now therefore, when I come to your servant my father, and the lad is not with us, since his life is bound up in the lad's life,(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:31: Genesis 44:31 it will happen, when he sees that the lad is not with us, that he will die. So your servants will bring down the gray hair of your servant our father with sorrow to the grave.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:32: Genesis 44:32 For your servant became surety for the lad to my father, saying, "˜If I do not bring him back to you, then I shall bear the blame before my father forever.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:33: Genesis 44:33 Now therefore, please let your servant remain instead of the lad as a slave to my lord, and let the lad go up with his brothers.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 44:34: Genesis 44:34 For how shall I go up to my father if the lad is not with me, lest perhaps I see the evil that would come upon my father?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:1: Genesis 45:1 Then Joseph could not restrain himself before all those who stood by him, and he cried out, "Make everyone go out from me!" So no one stood with him while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:2: Genesis 45:2 And he wept aloud, and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard it.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:3: Genesis 45:3 Then Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph; does my father still live?" But his brothers could not answer him, for they were dismayed in his presence.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:4: Genesis 45:4 And Joseph said to his brothers, "Please come near to me." So they came near. Then he said: "I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:5: Genesis 45:5 But now, do not therefore be grieved or angry with yourselves because you sold me here; for God sent me before you to preserve life.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:6: Genesis 45:6 For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are still five years in which there will be neither plowing nor harvesting.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:7: Genesis 45:7 And God sent me before you to preserve a posterity for you in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:8: Genesis 45:8 So now it was not you who sent me here, but God; and He has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:9: Genesis 45:9 "Hurry and go up to my father, and say to him, "˜Thus says your son Joseph: "God has made me lord of all Egypt; come down to me, do not tarry.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:10: Genesis 45:10 You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near to me, you and your children, your children's children, your flocks and your herds, and all that you have.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:11: Genesis 45:11 There I will provide for you, lest you and your household, and all that you have, come to poverty; for there are still five years of famine." '(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:12: Genesis 45:12 "And behold, your eyes and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see that it is my mouth that speaks to you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:13: Genesis 45:13 So you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen; and you shall hurry and bring my father down here."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:14: Genesis 45:14 Then he fell on his brother Benjamin's neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:15: Genesis 45:15 Moreover he kissed all his brothers and wept over them, and after that his brothers talked with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:16: Genesis 45:16 Now the report of it was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, "Joseph's brothers have come." So it pleased Pharaoh and his servants well.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:17: Genesis 45:17 And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Say to your brothers, "˜Do this: Load your animals and depart; go to the land of Canaan.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:18: Genesis 45:18 Bring your father and your households and come to me; I will give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:19: Genesis 45:19 Now you are commanded"”do this: Take carts out of the land of Egypt for your little ones and your wives; bring your father and come.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:20: Genesis 45:20 Also do not be concerned about your goods, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.' "(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:21: Genesis 45:21 Then the sons of Israel did so; and Joseph gave them carts, according to the command of Pharaoh, and he gave them provisions for the journey.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:22: Genesis 45:22 He gave to all of them, to each man, changes of garments; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of garments.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:23: Genesis 45:23 And he sent to his father these things: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and food for his father for the journey.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:24: Genesis 45:24 So he sent his brothers away, and they departed; and he said to them, "See that you do not become troubled along the way."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:25: Genesis 45:25 Then they went up out of Egypt, and came to the land of Canaan to Jacob their father.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:26: Genesis 45:26 And they told him, saying, "Joseph is still alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt." And Jacob's heart stood still, because he did not believe them.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:27: Genesis 45:27 But when they told him all the words which Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the carts which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 45:28: Genesis 45:28 Then Israel said, "It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:1: Genesis 46:1 So Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:2: Genesis 46:2 Then God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, "Jacob, Jacob!" And he said, "Here I am."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:3: Genesis 46:3 So He said, "I am God, the God of your father; do not fear to go down to Egypt, for I will make of you a great nation there.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:4: Genesis 46:4 I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will also surely bring you up again; and Joseph will put his hand on your eyes."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:5: Genesis 46:5 Then Jacob arose from Beersheba; and the sons of Israel carried their father Jacob, their little ones, and their wives, in the carts which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:6: Genesis 46:6 So they took their livestock and their goods, which they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and went to Egypt, Jacob and all his descendants with him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:7: Genesis 46:7 His sons and his sons' sons, his daughters and his sons' daughters, and all his descendants he brought with him to Egypt.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:8: Genesis 46:8 Now these were the names of the children of Israel, Jacob and his sons, who went to Egypt: Reuben was Jacob's firstborn.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:9: Genesis 46:9 The sons of Reuben were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:10: Genesis 46:10 The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:11: Genesis 46:11 The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:12: Genesis 46:12 The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah (but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:13: Genesis 46:13 The sons of Issachar were Tola, Puvah, Job, and Shimron.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:14: Genesis 46:14 The sons of Zebulun were Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:15: Genesis 46:15 These were the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Padan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the persons, his sons and his daughters, were thirty-three.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:16: Genesis 46:16 The sons of Gad were Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:17: Genesis 46:17 The sons of Asher were Jimnah, Ishuah, Isui, Beriah, and Serah, their sister. And the sons of Beriah were Heber and Malchiel.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:18: Genesis 46:18 These were the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; and these she bore to Jacob: sixteen persons.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:19: Genesis 46:19 The sons of Rachel, Jacob's wife, were Joseph and Benjamin.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:20: Genesis 46:20 And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-Pherah priest of On, bore to him.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:21: Genesis 46:21 The sons of Benjamin were Belah, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:22: Genesis 46:22 These were the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: fourteen persons in all.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:23: Genesis 46:23 The son of Dan was Hushim.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:24: Genesis 46:24 The sons of Naphtali were Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:25: Genesis 46:25 These were the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, and she bore these to Jacob: seven persons in all.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:26: Genesis 46:26 All the persons who went with Jacob to Egypt, who came from his body, besides Jacob's sons' wives, were sixty-six persons in all.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:27: Genesis 46:27 And the sons of Joseph who were born to him in Egypt were two persons. All the persons of the house of Jacob who went to Egypt were seventy.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:28: Genesis 46:28 Then he sent Judah before him to Joseph, to point out before him the way to Goshen. And they came to the land of Goshen.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:29: Genesis 46:29 So Joseph made ready his chariot and went up to Goshen to meet his father Israel; and he presented himself to him, and fell on his neck and wept on his neck a good while.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:30: Genesis 46:30 And Israel said to Joseph, "Now let me die, since I have seen your face, because you are still alive."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:31: Genesis 46:31 Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's household, "I will go up and tell Pharaoh, and say to him, "˜My brothers and those of my father's house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:32: Genesis 46:32 And the men are shepherds, for their occupation has been to feed livestock; and they have brought their flocks, their herds, and all that they have.'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:33: Genesis 46:33 So it shall be, when Pharaoh calls you and says, "˜What is your occupation?'(NKJV)
verses.genesis 46:34: Genesis 46:34 that you shall say, "˜Your servants' occupation has been with livestock from our youth even till now, both we and also our fathers,' that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:1: Genesis 47:1 Then Joseph went and told Pharaoh, and said, "My father and my brothers, their flocks and their herds and all that they possess, have come from the land of Canaan; and indeed they are in the land of Goshen."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:2: Genesis 47:2 And he took five men from among his brothers and presented them to Pharaoh.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:3: Genesis 47:3 Then Pharaoh said to his brothers, "What is your occupation?" And they said to Pharaoh, "Your servants are shepherds, both we and also our fathers."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:4: Genesis 47:4 And they said to Pharaoh, "We have come to dwell in the land, because your servants have no pasture for their flocks, for the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:5: Genesis 47:5 Then Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, "Your father and your brothers have come to you.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:6: Genesis 47:6 The land of Egypt is before you. Have your father and brothers dwell in the best of the land; let them dwell in the land of Goshen. And if you know any competent men among them, then make them chief herdsmen over my livestock."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:7: Genesis 47:7 Then Joseph brought in his father Jacob and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:8: Genesis 47:8 Pharaoh said to Jacob, "How old are you?"(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:9: Genesis 47:9 And Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The days of the years of my pilgrimage are one hundred and thirty years; few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:10: Genesis 47:10 So Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:11: Genesis 47:11 And Joseph situated his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:12: Genesis 47:12 Then Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all his father's household with bread, according to the number in their families.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:13: Genesis 47:13 Now there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan languished because of the famine.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:14: Genesis 47:14 And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought; and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh's house.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:15: Genesis 47:15 So when the money failed in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, "Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For the money has failed."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:16: Genesis 47:16 Then Joseph said, "Give your livestock, and I will give you bread for your livestock, if the money is gone."(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:17: Genesis 47:17 So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, the flocks, the cattle of the herds, and for the donkeys. Thus he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock that year.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:18: Genesis 47:18 When that year had ended, they came to him the next year and said to him, "We will not hide from my lord that our money is gone; my lord also has our herds of livestock. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord but our bodies and our lands.(NKJV)
verses.genesis 47:19: Genesis 47:19 Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants of Pharaoh; give us seed, that we may live and not die, that the land may not be desolate."(NKJV)
